rows.pali: Yattha yattha āsati nisīdati, taṃ āsanaṃ.
rows.english: wherever one seats oneself (āsati), sits (nisīdati), that is the seat (āsana).
rows.chinese_translation: 凡是他睡卧的地方，无论寺院、楼阁等，称为居住处。

rows.pali: Taṃ ekato katvā senāsananti vuccati.
rows.english: Both together are called “resting-place” (or “abode”—senāsana).
rows.chinese_translation: 凡是他坐着的地方，称为座处。

rows.pali: Utuparissayavinodanapaṭisallānārāmatthanti parisahanaṭṭhena utuyeva utuparissayo.
rows.english: For the purpose of warding off the perils of climate and enjoying retreat: the climate itself in the sense of imperilling (parisahana) is “perils of climate” (utu-parissaya).
rows.chinese_translation: 二者合在一起，就称为住处。

rows.pali: Utuparissayassa vinodanatthañca paṭisallānārāmatthañca. Yo sarīrābādhacittavikkhepakaro asappāyo utu senāsanapaṭisevanena vinodetabbo hoti, tassa vinodanatthaṃ ekībhāvasukhatthañcāti vuttaṃ hoti.
rows.english: Unsuitable climatic conditions that cause mental distraction due to bodily affliction can be warded off by making use of the resting place; it is for the purpose of warding off these and for the purpose of the pleasure of solitude, is what is meant.
rows.chinese_translation: “为了消除气候造成的障碍并享受独处”，气候本身因能造成苦受而称为气候障碍。

rows.pali: Kāmañca sītapaṭighātādināva utuparissayavinodanaṃ vuttameva.
rows.english: Of course, the warding off of the perils of climate is stated by [the phrase] “protection from cold,” etc., too;
rows.chinese_translation: 意思是为了消除气候障碍，也为了享受独处；身体疾病或心散乱所造成的不适气候，应通过受用住处来消除，也就是为了独处的安乐。

rows.pali: Yathā pana cīvarapaṭisevane hirikopīnapaṭicchādanaṃ niyatapayojanaṃ, itarāni kadāci kadāci bhavantīti vuttaṃ, evamidhāpi niyataṃ utuparissayavinodanaṃ sandhāya idaṃ vuttanti veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: but, just as in the case of making use of the robes the concealment of the private parts is stated as an invariable purpose while the others are periodical [purposes], so here also this [last] should be understood as mentioned with reference to the invariable warding off of the perils of climate.
rows.chinese_translation: 虽然前面已经以抵御寒冷等说明消除气候障碍，
rows.translation_note: 气候障碍指冷热等造成身体或心的不适。

rows.pali: Atha vā ayaṃ vuttappakāro utu utuyeva.
rows.english: Or alternatively, this “climate” of the kind stated is just climate;
rows.chinese_translation: 但如受用袈裟时遮蔽羞处是固定目的，其他目的有时才出现；这里也应理解为专指固定的消除气候障碍。

rows.pali: Parissayo pana duvidho pākaṭaparissayo ca, paṭicchannaparissayo ca (mahāni. 5).
rows.english: but “perils” are of two kinds: evident perils and concealed perils (see Nidd I 12).
rows.chinese_translation: 或者，前面所说的气候就是气候本身。

rows.pali: Tattha pākaṭaparissayo sīhabyagghādayo.
rows.english: Herein, evident perils are lions, tigers, etc.,
rows.chinese_translation: 障碍则有两种：明显的障碍和隐蔽的障碍。

rows.pali: Paṭicchannaparissayo rāgadosādayo.
rows.english: while concealed perils are greed, hate, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 其中，狮子、老虎等是明显的障碍。
rows.translation_note: 明显与隐蔽障碍分别是外在危险和内在烦恼。

rows.pali: Ye yattha apariguttiyā ca asappāyarūpadassanādinā ca ābādhaṃ na karonti, taṃ senāsanaṃ evaṃ jānitvā paccavekkhitvā paṭisevanto bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso senāsanaṃ utuparissayavinodanatthaṃ paṭisevatīti veditabbo.
rows.english: When a bhikkhu knows and reflects thus in making use of the kind of resting place where these [perils] do not, owing to unguarded doors and sight of unsuitable visible objects, etc., cause affliction, he can be understood as one who “reflecting wisely makes use of the resting place for the purpose of warding off the perils of climate.”
rows.chinese_translation: 贪欲、瞋恚等是隐蔽的障碍。

rows.pali: Gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāranti ettha rogassa paṭiayanaṭṭhena paccayo, paccanīkagamanaṭṭhenāti attho.
rows.english: 96.The requisite of medicine as cure for the sick: here “cure” (paccaya = going against) is in the sense of going against (pati-ayana) illness; in the sense of countering, is the meaning.
rows.chinese_translation: 比丘了解并反省何处没有防护，何处会因看见不适宜的色等而造成伤害；这样受用住处时，应知他是如理审察住处，为了消除气候障碍。

rows.pali: Yassa kassaci sappāyassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
rows.english: This is a term for any suitable remedy.
rows.chinese_translation: “病者所需的药物和资具”中，资具是对疾病的对治、走向相反方向的意思。

rows.pali: Bhisakkassa kammaṃ tena anuññātattāti bhesajjaṃ.
rows.english: It is the medical man’s work (bhisakkassa kammaṃ) because it is permitted by him, thus it is medicine (bhesajja).
rows.chinese_translation: 这是任何适合病者之物的名称。

rows.pali: Gilānapaccayova bhesajjaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaṃ, yaṃkiñci gilānassa sappāyaṃ bhisakkakammaṃ telamadhuphāṇitādīti vuttaṃ hoti.
rows.english: Or the cure for the sick itself as medicine is “medicine as cure for the sick. ” Any work of a medical man such as oil, honey, ghee, etc., that is suitable for one who is sick, is what is meant.
rows.chinese_translation: 因这是医生的工作，并且得到许可，所以称为药。

rows.pali: Parikkhāroti pana "sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhataṃ hotī"ti (a. ni. 7.67) ādīsu parivāro vuccati.
rows.english: A “requisite” (parikkhāra), however, in such passages as “It is well supplied with the requisites of a city” (A IV 106) is equipment;
rows.chinese_translation: 病者所需的资具本身就是药物，意思是凡适合病人的、由医生使用的油、蜂蜜、糖浆等。

rows.pali: "Ratho sīlaparikkhāro, jhānakkho cakkavīriyo"ti (saṃ. ni. 5.4) ādīsu alaṅkāro.
rows.english: in such passages as “The chariot has the requisite of virtue, the axle of jhāna, the wheel of energy” (S V 6) [35] it is an ornament;
rows.chinese_translation: “资具”在有些经文中指围绕、护卫。

rows.pali: "Ye ca kho ime pabbajitena jīvitaparikkhārā samudānetabbā"ti (ma. ni. 1.191-192) ādīsu sambhāro.
rows.english: in such passages as “The requisites for the life of one who has gone into homelessness that should be available” (M I 104), it is an accessory.
rows.chinese_translation: 在“戒是车的资具，禅是车轴，精进是车轮”等经文中，指装饰。

rows.pali: Idha pana sambhāropi parivāropi vaṭṭati.
rows.english: But here both equipment and accessory are applicable.
rows.chinese_translation: 在“出家人应当积集这些维持生命的资具”等经文中，指资粮。
rows.translation_note: parikkhāra 在不同引文中有围绕、装饰、资粮等义；此处按语境兼摄护持和资粮。

rows.pali: Tañhi gilānapaccayabhesajjaṃ jīvitassa parivāropi hoti, jīvitanāsakābādhuppattiyā antaraṃ adatvā rakkhaṇato sambhāropi.
rows.english: For that medicine as a cure for the sick is equipment for maintaining life because it protects by preventing the arising of affliction destructive to life;
rows.chinese_translation: 这里既可以指资粮，也可以指围绕、护卫。

rows.pali: Yathā ciraṃ pavattati, evamassa kāraṇabhāvato, tasmā parikkhāroti vuccati.
rows.english: and it is an accessory too because it is an instrument for prolonging life. That is why it is called “requisite.”
rows.chinese_translation: 因为病者所需的药物既是生命的护卫，又因防止疾病生起而不让生命中断，所以也是资粮。

rows.pali: Evaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjañca taṃ parikkhāro cāti gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāro.
rows.english: So it is medicine as cure for the sick and that is a requisite, thus it is a “requisite of medicine as cure for the sick.”
rows.chinese_translation: 它是使生命长久运行的原因，因此称为资具。

rows.pali: Taṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ.
rows.english: [He makes use of] that requisite of medicine as cure for the sick;
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是病者所需的药物资具。

rows.pali: Gilānassa yaṃkiñci sappāyaṃ bhisakkānuññātaṃ telamadhuphāṇitādi jīvitaparikkhāranti vuttaṃ hoti.
rows.english: any requisite for life consisting of oil, honey, molasses, ghee, etc., that is allowed by a medical man as suitable for the sick, is what is meant.
rows.chinese_translation: 意思是：凡适合病人的、医生许可的油、蜂蜜、糖浆等，都称为维持生命的资具。

rows.pali: Uppannānanti jātānaṃ bhūtānaṃ nibbattānaṃ.
rows.english: 97.From arisen: from born, become, produced.
rows.chinese_translation: “已经生起的”，是指已经出生、存在、产生的。
rows.translation_note: 疾病在此承接前文的医药语境，不是泛指所有不适。

rows.pali: Veyyābādhikānanti ettha byābādhoti dhātukkhobho, taṃsamuṭṭhānā ca kuṭṭhagaṇḍapīḷakādayo.
rows.english: Hurtful: here “hurt (affliction)” is a disturbance of elements, and it is the leprosy, tumours, boils, etc., originated by that disturbance.
rows.chinese_translation: “由疾病造成的”，这里的疾病是元素失调，以及由此产生的癣、疮、脓包等。

rows.pali: Byābādhato uppannattā veyyābādhikā.
rows.english: Hurtful (veyyābādhika) because arisen in the form of hurt (byābādha).
rows.chinese_translation: 因为由疾病产生，所以称为疾病造成的。

rows.pali: Vedanānanti dukkhavedanā akusalavipākavedanā.
rows.english: Feelings: painful feelings, feelings resulting from unprofitable kamma—
rows.chinese_translation: “受”是指苦受和不善异熟受。

rows.pali: Tāsaṃ veyyābādhikānaṃ vedanānaṃ.
rows.english: from those hurtful feelings.
rows.chinese_translation: 是指那些由疾病造成的受。

rows.pali: Abyābajjhaparamatāyāti niddukkhaparamatāya.
rows.english: For complete immunity from affliction: for complete freedom from pain;
rows.chinese_translation: “以无病为最高”是指以没有痛苦为最高。

rows.pali: Yāva taṃ dukkhaṃ sabbaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti tāvāti attho.
rows.english: so that all that is painful is abandoned, is the meaning.
rows.chinese_translation: 意思是：直到那一切痛苦都被完全舍弃为止。

rows.pali: Evamidaṃ saṅkhepato paṭisaṅkhā yoniso paccayaparibhogalakkhaṇaṃ paccayasannissitasīlaṃ veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: This is how this virtue concerning requisites should be understood. In brief its characteristic is the use of requisites after wise reflection.
rows.chinese_translation: 简要说来，应当知道，资具依止戒的特征，就是如理审察后受用资具。

rows.pali: Vacanattho panettha – cīvarādayo hi yasmā te paṭicca nissāya paribhuñjamānā pāṇino ayanti pavattanti, tasmā paccayāti vuccanti.
rows.english: The word-meaning here is this: because breathing things go (ayanti), move, proceed, using [what they use] in dependence on these robes, etc., these robes, etc., are therefore called requisites (paccaya = ger. of paṭi + ayati);
rows.chinese_translation: 语义上，衣服等资具是众生依靠、凭借它们而生活运行的，所以称为资具。

rows.pali: Te paccaye sannissitanti paccayasannissitaṃ.
rows.english: “concerning requisites” is concerning those requisites.
rows.chinese_translation: 依止这些资具，所以称为资具依止。

rows.pali: 19.Evametasmiṃ catubbidhe sīle saddhāya pātimokkhasaṃvaro sampādetabbo.
rows.english: 98.(a) So, in this fourfold virtue, Pātimokkha restraint has to be undertaken by means of faith.
rows.chinese_translation: 在这四种戒中，应当以信心成就别解脱律仪。

rows.pali: Saddhāsādhano hi so, sāvakavisayātītattā sikkhāpadapaññattiyā.
rows.english: For that is accomplished by faith, since the announcing of training precepts is outside the disciples’ province;
rows.chinese_translation: 因为别解脱律仪由信心成就，而学处的制定超越声闻的能力范围。

rows.pali: Sikkhāpadapaññattiyācanapaṭikkhepo cettha nidassanaṃ.
rows.english: and the evidence here is the refusal of the request to [allow disciples to] announce training precepts (see Vin III 9–10).
rows.chinese_translation: 这里，不请求制定学处以及拒绝请求，就是一个例证。
rows.translation_note: “不请求制定学处”是论证学处应信受奉行的例证。

rows.pali: Tasmā yathā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ anavasesaṃ saddhāya samādiyitvā jīvitepi apekkhaṃ akarontena sādhukaṃ sampādetabbaṃ.
rows.english: Having therefore undertaken through faith the training precepts without exception as announced, one should completely perfect them without regard for life.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，应当按照制定的学处，以信心完整受持，不遗留任何部分，甚至不顾惜生命，也要谨慎成就。

rows.pali: Vuttampi hetaṃ –
rows.english: For this is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 经中也说：

rows.pali: "Kikīva aṇḍaṃ camarīva vāladhiṃ,
rows.english: “As a hen guards her eggs, Or as a yak her tail,
rows.chinese_translation: “像孔雀爱护蛋，像旃陀罗牛爱护尾毛，

rows.pali: Piyaṃva puttaṃ nayanaṃva ekakaṃ;
rows.english: Or like a darling child, Or like an only eye—
rows.chinese_translation: 像爱护自己的孩子，像爱护唯一的眼睛；

rows.pali: Tatheva sīlaṃ anurakkhamānakā,
rows.english: So you who are engaged Your virtue to protect,
rows.chinese_translation: 同样，守护戒行的人，

rows.pali: Supesalā hotha sadā sagāravā"ti.
rows.english: Be prudent at all times And ever scrupulous.” (Source untraced)
rows.chinese_translation: 应当始终柔和而恭敬。”

rows.pali: Aparampi vuttaṃ – "evameva kho pahārāda yaṃ mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ, taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetupi nātikkamantī"ti (a. ni. 8.19).
rows.english: Also it is said further: “So too, sire, when a training precept for disciples is announced by me, my disciples do not transgress it even for the sake of life” (A IV 201).
rows.chinese_translation: 经中还说：“帕哈罗陀，正如我为弟子制定的学处，我的弟子即使为了生命，也不违犯它。”

rows.pali: Imasmiṃ ca panatthe aṭaviyaṃ corehi baddhatherānaṃ vatthūni veditabbāni.
rows.english: 99.And the story of the elders bound by robbers in the forest should be understood in this sense.
rows.chinese_translation: 关于这一点，应当知道森林中被盗贼捆绑的长老们的故事。

rows.pali: Mahāvattaniaṭaviyaṃ kira theraṃ corā kāḷavallīhi bandhitvā nipajjāpesuṃ.
rows.english: It seems that robbers in the Mahāvaṭṭanī Forest bound an elder with black creepers and made him lie down.
rows.chinese_translation: 据说，在大瓦特尼森林中，盗贼用黑藤把一位长老捆起来，让他躺下。

rows.pali: Thero yathānipannova sattadivasāni vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā anāgāmiphalaṃ pāpuṇitvā tattheva kālaṃ katvā brahmaloke nibbatti.
rows.english: While he lay there for seven days he augmented his insight, and after reaching the fruition of non-return, he died there and was reborn in the Brahmā-world.
rows.chinese_translation: 长老保持原来的姿势，增长观禅七天，证得不还果，随后在那里命终，投生梵天。

rows.pali: Aparampi theraṃ tambapaṇṇidīpe pūtilatāya bandhitvā nipajjāpesuṃ.
rows.english: Also they bound another elder in Tambapaṇṇi Island (Sri Lanka) with string creepers and made him lie down.
rows.chinese_translation: 另有一位长老在楞伽岛被腐藤捆起来躺下。
rows.translation_note: samasīsī 是在同一生命阶段完成道果并命终的称呼。

rows.pali: So vanadāhe āgacchante valliṃ acchinditvāva vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā samasīsī hutvā parinibbāyi.
rows.english: When a forest fire came and the creepers were not cut, he established insight and attained Nibbāna simultaneously with his death.
rows.chinese_translation: 森林大火逼近时，他没有砍断藤条，就开始修观，成为等首比丘而般涅槃。

rows.pali: Dīghabhāṇakaabhayatthero pañcahi bhikkhusatehi saddhiṃ āgacchanto disvā therassa sarīraṃ jhāpetvā cetiyaṃ kārāpesi.
rows.english: When the Elder Abhaya, a preacher of the Dīgha Nikāya, passed by with five hundred bhikkhus, he saw [what had happened] and he had the elder’s body cremated and a shrine built.
rows.chinese_translation: 长部诵者阿毗耶长老带着五百比丘经过，看见长老的遗体，便火化并建塔供奉。

rows.pali: Tasmā aññopi saddho kulaputto –
rows.english: Therefore let other clansmen also:
rows.chinese_translation: 所以，另一个有信心的善男子也应当说：

rows.pali: Pātimokkhaṃ visodhento, appeva jīvitaṃ jahe;
rows.english: Maintain the rules of conduct pure, Renouncing life if there be need,
rows.chinese_translation: “即使舍弃生命，也要清净别解脱；

rows.pali: Paññattaṃ lokanāthena, na bhinde sīlasaṃvaraṃ.
rows.english: Rather than break virtue’s restraint By the World’s Saviour decreed.
rows.chinese_translation: 世界之主制定的戒律，绝不破坏戒的防护。”

rows.pali: Yathā ca pātimokkhasaṃvaro saddhāya, evaṃ satiyā indriyasaṃvaro sampādetabbo.
rows.english: 100.(b) And as Pātimokkha restraint is undertaken out of faith, so restraint of the sense faculties should be undertaken with mindfulness.
rows.chinese_translation: 正如别解脱律仪以信心成就，根律仪也应以正念成就。

rows.pali: Satisādhano hi so, satiyā adhiṭṭhitānaṃ indriyānaṃ abhijjhādīhi ananvāssavanīyato.
rows.english: For that is accomplished by mindfulness, because when the sense faculties’ functions are founded on mindfulness, there is no liability to invasion by covetousness and the rest.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为根律仪由正念成就；被正念建立的诸根，不会被贪欲等侵入。

rows.pali: Tasmā "varaṃ, bhikkhave, tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhundriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tveva cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho"ti (saṃ. ni. 4.235) ādinā nayena ādittapariyāyaṃ samanussaritvā rūpādīsu visayesu cakkhudvārādipavattassa viññāṇassa abhijjhādīhi anvāssavanīyaṃ nimittādiggāhaṃ asammuṭṭhāya satiyā nisedhentena esa sādhukaṃ sampādetabbo.
rows.english: So, recollecting the Fire Discourse, which begins thus, “Better, bhikkhus, the extirpation of the eye faculty by a red-hot burning blazing glowing iron spike than the apprehension of signs in the particulars of visible objects cognizable by the eye” (S IV 168), this [restraint] should be properly undertaken by preventing with unremitting mindfulness any apprehension, in the objective fields consisting of visible data, etc., of any signs, etc., likely to encourage covetousness, etc., to invade consciousness occurring in connection with the eye door, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，应忆念“燃烧的譬喻”等教法，以正念阻止眼门等所起的识在色等境上取总相、细相，而让贪欲等侵入；这样才能谨慎成就根律仪。
rows.translation_note: 这里的“燃烧譬喻”承接经文对感官防护的警策。

rows.pali: Evaṃ asampādite hi etasmiṃ pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlampi anaddhaniyaṃ hoti aciraṭṭhitikaṃ, asaṃvihitasākhāparivāramiva sassaṃ.
rows.english: 101. When not undertaken thus, virtue of Pātimokkha restraint is unenduring: it does not last, like a crop not fenced in with branches.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果根律仪没有这样成就，别解脱律仪戒也不稳固、不能长久，就像枝叶没有妥善围护的庄稼。

rows.pali: Haññate cāyaṃ kilesacorehi, vivaṭadvāro viya gāmo parassa hārīhi.
rows.english: And it is raided by the robber defilements as a village with open gates is by thieves.
rows.chinese_translation: 它会被烦恼盗贼毁坏，就像门户敞开的村庄被掠夺者劫掠。

rows.pali: Cittañcassa rāgo samativijjhati, ducchannamagāraṃ vuṭṭhi viya.
rows.english: And lust leaks into his mind as rain does into a badly-roofed house.
rows.chinese_translation: 贪欲会穿透他的心，就像雨水穿透破旧的屋顶。

rows.pali: Vuttampi hetaṃ –
rows.english: For this is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 经中也说：

rows.pali: "Rūpesu saddesu atho rasesu,
rows.english: “Among the visible objects, sounds, and smells,
rows.chinese_translation: “对色、声，以及味，

rows.pali: Gandhesu phassesu ca rakkha indriyaṃ;
rows.english: And tastes, and tangibles, guard the faculties;
rows.chinese_translation: 对香和触，都要守护诸根；

rows.pali: Ete hi dvārā vivaṭā arakkhitā,
rows.english: For when these doors are open and unguarded,
rows.chinese_translation: 这些门若敞开而无防护，
rows.translation_note: 偈颂以村庄和房屋作比，分别说明根门与心的防护。

rows.pali: Hananti gāmaṃva parassa hārino".
rows.english: Then thieves will come and raid as ’twere a village (? ).
rows.chinese_translation: 便会像掠夺者摧毁村庄。”

rows.pali: "Yathā agāraṃ ducchannaṃ, vuṭṭhī samativijjhati;
rows.english: And just as with an ill-roofed house The rain comes leaking in, so too
rows.chinese_translation: “正如破屋会被雨水穿透，

rows.pali: Evaṃ abhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo samativijjhatī"ti. (dha. pa. 13);
rows.english: Will lust come leaking in for sure Upon an undeveloped mind” (Dhp 13).
rows.chinese_translation: 未修习的心也会被贪欲穿透。”

rows.pali: Sampādite pana tasmiṃ pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlampi addhaniyaṃ hoti ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, susaṃvihitasākhāparivāramiva sassaṃ.
rows.english: 102. When it is undertaken thus, virtue of Pātimokkha restraint is enduring: it lasts, like a crop well fenced in with branches.
rows.chinese_translation: 但如果根律仪成就，别解脱律仪戒也稳固而长久，就像枝叶妥善围护的庄稼。

rows.pali: Na haññate cāyaṃ kilesacorehi, susaṃvutadvāro viya gāmo parassa hārīhi.
rows.english: And it is not raided by the robber defilements, as a village with well-guarded gates is not by thieves.
rows.chinese_translation: 它不会被烦恼盗贼毁坏，就像门户严密防护的村庄不会被掠夺者劫掠。

rows.pali: Na cassa cittaṃ rāgo samativijjhati, succhannamagāraṃ vuṭṭhi viya.
rows.english: And lust does not leak into his mind, as rain does not into a well-roofed house.
rows.chinese_translation: 贪欲也不会穿透他的心，就像雨水不能穿透屋顶完好的房屋。

rows.pali: Vuttampi cetaṃ –
rows.english: For this is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 经中还说：

rows.pali: "Rūpesu saddesu atho rasesu,
rows.english: “Among the visible objects, sounds and smells,
rows.chinese_translation: “对色、声，以及味，

rows.pali: Gandhesu phassesu ca rakkha indriyaṃ;
rows.english: And tastes and tangibles, guard the faculties;
rows.chinese_translation: 对香和触，都要守护诸根；

rows.pali: Ete hi dvārā pihitā susaṃvutā,
rows.english: For when these doors are closed and truly guarded,
rows.chinese_translation: 这些门已经关闭，严密防护，

rows.pali: Na hanti gāmaṃva parassa hārino".
rows.english: Thieves will not come and raid as ’twere a village (? ).
rows.chinese_translation: 所以不会像掠夺者那样毁坏村庄。”

rows.pali: "Yathā agāraṃ succhannaṃ, vuṭṭhī na samativijjhati;
rows.english: “And just as with a well-roofed house No rain comes leaking in, so too
rows.chinese_translation: “正如屋顶完好的房屋不会被雨水穿透，

rows.pali: Evaṃ subhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo na samativijjhatī"ti. (dha. pa. 14);
rows.english: No lust comes leaking in for sure Upon a well-developed mind” (Dhp 14).
rows.chinese_translation: 同样，善加修习的心不会被贪欲穿透。”

rows.pali: Ayaṃ pana atiukkaṭṭhadesanā.
rows.english: 103. This, however, is the teaching at its very highest.
rows.chinese_translation: 不过，这已经是最为严格的教说。

rows.pali: Cittaṃ nāmetaṃ lahuparivattaṃ, tasmā uppannaṃ rāgaṃ asubhamanasikārena vinodetvā indriyasaṃvaro sampādetabbo, adhunāpabbajitena vaṅgīsattherena viya.
rows.english: This mind is called “quickly transformed” (A I 10), so restraint of the faculties should be undertaken by removing arisen lust with the contemplation of foulness, as was done by the Elder Vaṅgīsa soon after he had gone forth.
rows.chinese_translation: 心是轻快而变化迅速的，所以应以不净作意驱除已经生起的贪欲，以此成就根律仪，就像新近出家的梵耆沙长老一样。

rows.pali: Therassa kira adhunāpabbajitassa piṇḍāya carato ekaṃ itthiṃ disvā rāgo uppajjati.
rows.english: As the elder was wandering for alms, it seems, soon after going forth, lust arose in him on seeing a woman.
rows.chinese_translation: 据说，长老刚出家行乞时看见一个女人，贪欲便生起。

rows.pali: Tato ānandattheraṃ āha –
rows.english: Thereupon he said to the venerable Ānanda:
rows.chinese_translation: 于是他对阿难长老说：

rows.pali: "Kāmarāgena ḍayhāmi, cittaṃ me pariḍayhati;
rows.english: “I am afire with sensual lust. And burning flames consume my mind;
rows.chinese_translation: “我被欲贪烧灼，我的心在燃烧；

rows.pali: Sādhu nibbāpanaṃ brūhi, anukampāya gotamā"ti. (saṃ. ni. 1.212; theragā. 1232);
rows.english: In pity tell me, Gotama, How to extinguish it for good” (S I 188).
rows.chinese_translation: 请慈悲地告诉我善巧的灭火方法，乔答摩。”

rows.pali: Thero āha –
rows.english: The elder said:
rows.chinese_translation: 长老说：

rows.pali: "Saññāya vipariyesā, cittaṃ te pariḍayhati;
rows.english: “You do perceive mistakenly, That burning flames consume your mind.
rows.chinese_translation: “你的心因颠倒的想法而燃烧；

rows.pali: Nimittaṃ parivajjehi, subhaṃ rāgūpasañhitaṃ;
rows.english: Look for no sign of beauty there, For that it is which leads to lust.
rows.chinese_translation: 避开那与美好相应、能助长贪欲的相；

rows.pali: Asubhāya cittaṃ bhāvehi, ekaggaṃ susamāhitaṃ. (saṃ. ni. 1.212; theragā. 1233-1234);
rows.english: See foulness there and keep your mind Harmoniously concentrated;
rows.chinese_translation: 修习不净观，使心专一而善定。

rows.pali: "Saṅkhāre parato passa, dukkhato no ca attato;
rows.english: Formations see as alien, As ill, not self, so this great lust
rows.chinese_translation: 观察诸行是他法、是苦，不要把它们看作自我；
rows.translation_note: 偈颂将诸行分析为无常、苦、非我；“他法”译为非自我。

rows.pali: Nibbāpehi mahārāgaṃ, mā ḍayhittho punappuna"nti. (saṃ. ni. 1.212);
rows.english: May be extinguished, and no more Take fire thus ever and again” (S I 188).
rows.chinese_translation: 熄灭强烈的贪欲，不要反复被它烧灼。”

rows.pali: Thero rāgaṃ vinodetvā piṇḍāya cari.
rows.english: The elder expelled his lust and then went on with his alms round.
rows.chinese_translation: 长老驱除贪欲后，继续行乞。

rows.pali: Apica indriyasaṃvarapūrakena bhikkhunā kuraṇḍakamahāleṇavāsinā cittaguttattherena viya corakamahāvihāravāsinā mahāmittattherena viya ca bhavitabbaṃ.
rows.english: 104.Moreover, a bhikkhu who is fulfilling restraint of the faculties should be like the Elder Cittagutta resident in the Great Cave at Kuraṇḍaka, and like the Elder Mahā Mitta resident at the Great Monastery of Coraka.
rows.chinese_translation: 此外，修习根律仪的比丘，应当像住在拘兰达大岩窟的护心长老，以及住在偷盗大寺的友爱长老那样修行。
rows.translation_note: cittagutta 指护心、守护心念；mahāmitta 指大友或大慈友。

rows.pali: Kuraṇḍakamahāleṇe kira sattannaṃ buddhānaṃ abhinikkhamanacittakammaṃ manoramaṃ ahosi, sambahulā bhikkhū senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā cittakammaṃ disvā "manoramaṃ, bhante, cittakamma"nti āhaṃsu.
rows.english: 105.In the Great Cave of Kuraṇḍaka, it seems, there was a lovely painting of the Renunciation of the Seven Buddhas. A number of bhikkhus wandering about among the dwellings saw the painting and said, “What a lovely painting, venerable sir!
rows.chinese_translation: 据说，拘兰达大岩窟中有七位佛出家的美妙壁画；许多比丘巡行住处时看见壁画，说：“尊者，这壁画真美。”

rows.pali: Thero āha "atirekasaṭṭhi me, āvuso, vassāni leṇe vasantassa cittakammaṃ atthītipi na jānāmi, ajja dāni cakkhumante nissāya ñāta"nti.
rows.english: ” The elder said: “For more than sixty years, friends, I have lived in the cave, and I did not know whether there was any painting there or not.
rows.chinese_translation: 长老说：“诸位朋友，我住在这个岩窟已经六十多年，甚至不知道这里有壁画；今天只是依靠有眼睛的人才知道。”

rows.pali: Therena kira ettakaṃ addhānaṃ vasantena cakkhuṃ ummīletvā leṇaṃ na ullokitapubbaṃ.
rows.english: Now, today, I know it through those who have eyes.” The elder, it seems, though he had lived there for so long, had never raised his eyes and looked up at the cave.
rows.chinese_translation: 据说，长老住了这么久，从未睁眼向上看过岩窟。

rows.pali: Leṇadvāre cassa mahānāgarukkhopi ahosi.
rows.english: And at the door of his cave there was a great ironwood tree.
rows.chinese_translation: 岩窟门口还有一棵大龙树。

rows.pali: Sopi therena uddhaṃ na ullokitapubbo.
rows.english: And the elder had never looked up at that either.
rows.chinese_translation: 长老也从未抬头看过它。

rows.pali: Anusaṃvaccharaṃ bhūmiyaṃ kesaranipātaṃ disvāvassa pupphitabhāvaṃ jānāti.
rows.english: He knew it was in flower when he saw its petals on the ground each year.
rows.chinese_translation: 他每年只看见地上落下的橙色花瓣，便知道树已开花。

rows.pali: Rājā therassa guṇasampattiṃ sutvā vanditukāmo tikkhattuṃ pesetvā anāgacchante there tasmiṃ gāme taruṇaputtānaṃ itthīnaṃ thane bandhāpetvā lañjāpesi "tāva dārakā thaññaṃ mā labhiṃsu, yāva thero na āgacchatī"ti.
rows.english: 106. The king heard of the elder’s great virtues, and he sent for him three times, desiring to pay homage to him. When the elder did not go, he had the breasts of all the women with infants in the town bound and sealed off, [saying] “As long as the elder does not come let the children go without milk,”
rows.chinese_translation: 国王听闻长老的功德，想来礼敬，三次派人邀请，长老都没有来；国王便让村中年轻女子给孩子断奶，并惩罚她们，说：“在长老来之前，不许这些孩子得到奶。”

rows.pali: Thero dārakānaṃ anukampāya mahāgāmaṃ agamāsi.
rows.english: Out of compassion for the children the elder went to Mahāgāma.
rows.chinese_translation: 长老出于怜悯孩子们，便前往大村。

rows.pali: Rājā sutvā "gacchatha bhaṇe, theraṃ pavesetha sīlāni gaṇhissāmī"ti antepuraṃ abhiharāpetvā vanditvā bhojetvā "ajja, bhante, okāso natthi, sve sīlāni gaṇhissāmīti therassa pattaṃ gahetvā thokaṃ anugantvā deviyā saddhiṃ vanditvā nivatti.
rows.english: When the king heard [that he had come, he said] “Go and bring the elder in. I shall take the precepts.” Having had him brought up into the inner palace, he paid homage to him and provided him with a meal. Then, saying, “Today, venerable sir, there is no opportunity. I shall take the precepts tomorrow,” he took the elder’s bowl. After following him for a little, he paid homage with the queen and turned back.
rows.chinese_translation: 国王听说后说：“去吧，把长老请进来，我要受戒。”于是请长老到内宫，礼敬、供食，并说：“今天没有时间，明天我来受戒。”国王拿过长老的钵，陪行一段，又与王后礼敬后返回。

rows.pali: Thero rājā vā vandatu devī vā, "sukhī hotu, mahārājā"ti vadati.
rows.english: whether it was the king who paid homage or whether it was the queen, the elder said, “May the king be happy.”
rows.chinese_translation: 无论国王礼敬，还是王后礼敬，长老都只说：“大王，愿您幸福。”
rows.translation_note: 长老不作身份分别，体现对境界不取相。

rows.pali: Evaṃ sattadivasā gatā.
rows.english: As seven days went by thus (above).
rows.chinese_translation: 七天就这样过去了。

rows.pali: Bhikkhū āhaṃsu "kiṃ, bhante, tumhe raññepi vandamāne deviyāpi vandamānāya "sukhī hotu, mahārāja"icceva vadathāti.
rows.english: 107. Bhikkhus asked: “Why is it, venerable sir, that whether it is the king who pays the homage or the queen you say ‘May the king be happy’?
rows.chinese_translation: 比丘们问：“尊者，为什么国王礼敬、王后也礼敬时，您都只说‘大王，愿您幸福’？”

rows.pali: Thero "nāhaṃ, āvuso, rājāti vā devīti vā vavatthānaṃ karomī"ti vatvā sattāhātikkamena "therassa idha vāso dukkho"ti raññā vissajjito kuraṇḍakamahāleṇaṃ gantvā rattibhāge caṅkamaṃ ārūhi.
rows.english: ” The elder replied: “Friends, I do not notice whether it is the king or the queen.” At the end of seven days [when it was found that] the elder was not happy living there, he was dismissed by the king. He went back to the Great Cave at Kuraṇḍaka. When it was night he went out onto his walk.
rows.chinese_translation: 长老说：“朋友，我不作‘国王’或‘王后’这样的分别。”七天后，国王认为“长老住在这里很痛苦”，便放长老离去；长老回到拘兰达大岩窟，夜间登上经行道。

rows.pali: Nāgarukkhe adhivatthā devatā daṇḍadīpikaṃ gahetvā aṭṭhāsi.
rows.english: A deity who dwelt in the ironwood tree stood by with a torch of sticks.
rows.chinese_translation: 住在龙树上的天神手持灯火站在那里。

rows.pali: Athassa kammaṭṭhānaṃ atiparisuddhaṃ pākaṭaṃ ahosi.
rows.english: Then his meditation subject became quite clear and plain.
rows.chinese_translation: 于是他的业处变得极其清净、明朗。

rows.pali: Thero "kiṃ nu me ajja kammaṭṭhānaṃ ativiya pakāsatī"ti attamano majjhimayāmasamanantaraṃ sakalaṃ pabbataṃ unnādayanto arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
rows.english: The elder, [thinking] “How clear my meditation subject is today! ” was glad, and immediately after the middle watch he reached Arahantship, making the whole rock resound.30
rows.chinese_translation: 长老心想：“今天我的业处为什么格外明朗？”他心生欢喜，在中夜刚过时，声音震动整座山，证得阿罗汉果。

rows.pali: Tasmā aññopi attatthakāmo kulaputto –
rows.english: 108. So when another clansman seeks his own good:
rows.chinese_translation: 所以，另一个希望自利的善男子也应当：

rows.pali: Makkaṭova araññamhi, vane bhantamigo viya;
rows.english: Let him not be hungry-eyed, Like a monkey in the groves,
rows.chinese_translation: 像猴子在森林中一样，像迷失的野兽在林中一样；

rows.pali: Bālo viya ca utrasto, na bhave lolalocano.
rows.english: Like a wild deer in the woods, Like a nervous little child.
rows.chinese_translation: 像愚人受到惊吓一样，不要成为眼目游移的人。

rows.pali: Adho khipeyya cakkhūni, yugamattadaso siyā;
rows.english: Let him go with eyes downcast Seeing a plough yoke’s length before,
rows.chinese_translation: 眼睛应当向下，视线只及一轭距离；

rows.pali: Vanamakkaṭalolassa, na cittassa vasaṃ vaje.
rows.english: That he fall not in the power Of the forest-monkey mind.
rows.chinese_translation: 不要受那颗像森林猴般眼目游移的心支配。

rows.pali: Mahāmittattherassāpi mātu visagaṇḍakarogo uppajji, dhītāpissā bhikkhunīsu pabbajitā hoti.
rows.english: 109. The Elder Mahā Mitta’s mother was sick with a poisoned tumour. She told her daughter, who as a bhikkhunī had also gone forth
rows.chinese_translation: 大友长老的母亲也生了毒疮一类的疾病，她的女儿已在比丘尼中出家。
rows.translation_note: “真实语”是以持戒事实作为疗愈因缘的誓言式表达。

rows.pali: Sā taṃ āha – "gaccha ayye, bhātu santikaṃ gantvā mama aphāsukabhāvaṃ ārocetvā bhesajjamāharā"ti.
rows.english: , “Lady, go to your brother. Tell him my trouble and bring back some medicine.”
rows.chinese_translation: 母亲对她说：“女儿，去见你的兄长，把我的不适告诉他，请他带药来。”

rows.pali: Sā gantvā ārocesi.
rows.english: She went and told him.
rows.chinese_translation: 她去后把病情告诉长老。

rows.pali: Thero āha – "nāhaṃ mūlabhesajjādīni saṃharitvā bhesajjaṃ pacituṃ jānāmi, apica te bhesajjaṃ ācikkhissaṃ – "ahaṃ yato pabbajito, tato paṭṭhāya na mayā lobhasahagatena cittena indriyāni bhinditvā visabhāgarūpaṃ olokitapubbaṃ, iminā saccavacanena mātuyā me phāsu hotu, gaccha idaṃ vatvā upāsikāya sarīraṃ parimajjā"ti.
rows.english: The elder said: “I do not know how to gather root medicines and such things and concoct a medicine from them. But rather I will tell you a medicine: since I went forth I have not broken [my virtue of restraint of] the sense faculties by looking at the bodily form of the opposite sex with a lustful mind. By this declaration of truth may my mother get well. Go and tell the lay devotee and rub her body.”
rows.chinese_translation: 长老说：“我不会收集根本药材等来煎药，不过我告诉你一种药：自从我出家以来，从未以贪欲相应的心破坏诸根而观看异性。愿凭这真实语，我的母亲得到安乐。你去把这话告诉优婆夷，再抚摩她的身体。”

rows.pali: Sā gantvā imamatthaṃ ārocetvā tathā akāsi.
rows.english: She went and told her what had happened and then did as she had been instructed.
rows.chinese_translation: 她回去说明此事，并照做。

rows.pali: Upāsikāya taṃkhaṇaṃyeva gaṇḍo pheṇapiṇḍo viya vilīyitvā antaradhāyi, sā uṭṭhahitvā "sace sammāsambuddho dhareyya, kasmā mama puttasadisassa bhikkhuno jālavicitrena hatthena sīsaṃ na parāmaseyyā"ti attamanavācaṃ nicchāresi.
rows.english: At that very moment the lay devotee’s tumour vanished, shrinking away like a lump of froth. She got up and uttered a cry of joy: “If the Fully Enlightened One were still alive, why should he not stroke with his netadorned hand the head of a bhikkhu like my son?”
rows.chinese_translation: 优婆夷的疮当下就像一团泡沫般融化消失；她站起来，欢喜地说：“如果正等正觉者仍在世，他为什么不以那双绣满法界的手，抚摩像我儿子一样的比丘的头呢？”
rows.translation_note: “绣满法界的手”是赞颂佛陀手相的譬喻性表达。

rows.pali: Tasmā –
rows.english: So:
rows.chinese_translation: 因此：

rows.pali: Kulaputtamāni aññopi, pabbajitvāna sāsane;
rows.english: 110. Let another noble clansman Gone forth in the Dispensation
rows.chinese_translation: “另一个善男子也应当出家进入教法，

rows.pali: Mittattherova tiṭṭheyya, vare indriyasaṃvare.
rows.english: Keep, as did the Elder Mitta, Perfect faculty restraint.
rows.chinese_translation: 像友爱长老一样，安住于殊胜的根律仪中。”

rows.pali: Yathā pana indriyasaṃvaro satiyā, tathā vīriyena ājīvapārisuddhi sampādetabbā.
rows.english: 111.(c) As restraint of the faculties is to be undertaken by means of mindfulness, so livelihood purification is to be undertaken by means of energy.
rows.chinese_translation: 正如根律仪依靠正念成就，活命清净也应依靠精进成就。

rows.pali: Vīriyasādhanā hi sā, sammāraddhavīriyassa micchājīvappahānasambhavato.
rows.english: For that is accomplished by energy, because the abandoning of wrong livelihood is effected in one who has rightly applied energy.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为活命清净由精进成就；精进正确而充足时，便能舍弃邪命。

rows.pali: Tasmā anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ pahāya vīriyena piṇḍapātacariyādīhi sammā esanāhi esā sampādetabbā parisuddhuppādeyeva paccaye paṭisevamānena aparisuddhuppāde āsīvise viya parivajjayatā.
rows.english: Abandoning, therefore, unbefitting wrong search, this should be undertaken with energy by means of the right kind of search consisting in going on alms round, etc., avoiding what is of impure origin as though it were a poisonous snake, and using only requisites of pure origin.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，应当舍弃不正当的寻找，以精进从事乞食等正确的寻找；只受用清净所得的资具，像躲避毒蛇一样躲避不清净所得的资具。
rows.translation_note: anesanā 与 parisuddhuppāda 构成正当寻找与清净所得的对比。

rows.pali: Tattha apariggahitadhutaṅgassa saṅghato, gaṇato, dhammadesanādīhi cassa guṇehi pasannānaṃ gihīnaṃ santikā uppannā paccayā parisuddhuppādā nāma.
rows.english: 112.Herein, for one who has not taken up the ascetic practices, any requisites obtained from the Community, from a group of bhikkhus, or from laymen who have confidence in his special qualities of teaching the Dhamma, etc., are called “of pure origin.”
rows.chinese_translation: 对于没有受持头陀支的人，从僧团、团体以及因说法等功德而生信的在家人处得到的资具，称为清净所得。

rows.pali: Piṇḍapātacariyādīhi pana atiparisuddhuppādāyeva.
rows.english: But those obtained on alms round, etc., are of extremely pure origin.
rows.chinese_translation: 通过乞食等方式得到的资具，则称为极其清净所得。

rows.pali: Pariggahitadhutaṅgassa piṇḍapātacariyādīhi dhutaguṇe cassa pasannānaṃ santikā dhutaṅganiyamānulomena uppannā parisuddhuppādā nāma.
rows.english: For one who has taken up the ascetic practices, those obtained on alms round, etc., and—as long as this is in accordance with the rules of the ascetic practices—from people who have confidence in his special qualities of asceticism, are called “of pure origin.”
rows.chinese_translation: 对于受持头陀支的人，由乞食等方式，或从因其头陀功德而生信的人处，依头陀支规定相应得到的资具，称为清净所得。
rows.translation_note: 头陀支对资具来源和受用方式有更严格的限定。

rows.pali: Ekabyādhivūpasamatthañcassa pūtihariṭakīcatumadhuresu uppannesu "catumadhuraṃ aññepi sabrahmacārino paribhuñjissantī"ti cintetvā hariṭakīkhaṇḍameva paribhuñjamānassa dhutaṅgasamādānaṃ patirūpaṃ hoti.
rows.english: And if he has got putrid urine with mixed gall nuts and “four-sweets”31 for the purpose of curing a certain affliction, and he eats only the broken gall nuts, thinking, “Other companions in the life of purity will eat the ‘four-sweets’,” his undertaking of the ascetic practices is befitting,
rows.note: 31. “Four-sweets”—catumadhura: a medicinal sweet made of four ingredients: honey, palm-sugar, ghee and sesame oil.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果为了治愈一种疾病而得到腐牛尿、哈里达果和四甜药，修行者想“其他同梵行者也会受用四甜药”，因而只食用哈里达果片，这样受持头陀支是适当的。

rows.pali: Esa hi "uttamaariyavaṃsiko bhikkhū"ti vuccati.
rows.english: for he is then called a bhikkhu who is supreme in the Noble Ones’ heritages (A II 28).
rows.chinese_translation: 这样的人称为“最上等的圣族比丘”。

rows.pali: Ye panete cīvarādayo paccayā, tesu yassa kassaci bhikkhuno ājīvaṃ parisodhentassa cīvare ca piṇḍapāte ca nimittobhāsaparikathāviññattiyo na vaṭṭanti.
rows.english: 113. As to the robe and the other requisites, no hint, indication, roundabout talk, or intimation about robes and alms food is allowable for a bhikkhu who is purifying his livelihood.
rows.chinese_translation: 在衣物等资具中，任何比丘为了清净活命，都不应在衣物和食物方面使用暗示、显露、迂回说法或直接请求。
rows.translation_note: 衣食方面禁止暗示等，住处方面对未受头陀支者有较宽规定。

rows.pali: Senāsane pana apariggahitadhutaṅgassa nimittobhāsaparikathā vaṭṭanti.
rows.english: But a hint, indication, or roundabout talk about a resting place is allowable for one who has not taken up the ascetic practices.
rows.chinese_translation: 但对于没有受持头陀支的人，在住处方面可以使用暗示、显露和迂回说法。

rows.pali: Tattha nimittaṃ nāma senāsanatthaṃ bhūmiparikammādīni karontassa "kiṃ, bhante, kariyati, ko kārāpetī"ti gihīhi vutte "na koci"ti paṭivacanaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi evarūpaṃ nimittakammaṃ.
rows.english: 114. Herein, a “hint” is when one who is getting the preparing of the ground, etc., done for the purpose of [making] a resting place is asked, “What is being done, venerable sir? Who is having it done? ” and he replies, “No one”; or any other such giving of hints.
rows.chinese_translation: 其中，“暗示”是居士为住处整地等时问“尊者，在做什么？谁让人做的”，比丘回答“没有人”，或其他类似的暗示行为。

rows.pali: Obhāso nāma "upāsakā tumhe kuhiṃ vasathā"ti.
rows.english: An “indication” is saying, “Lay follower, where do you live?”
rows.chinese_translation: “显露”是说：“居士，你们住在哪里？”

rows.pali: Pāsāde, bhanteti.
rows.english: —”In a mansion, venerable sir”
rows.chinese_translation: “在宫殿里，尊者。”

rows.pali: "Bhikkhūnaṃ pana upāsakā pāsādo na vaṭṭatī"ti vacanaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi evarūpaṃ obhāsakammaṃ.
rows.english: —”But, lay follower, a mansion is not allowed for bhikkhus.” Or any other such giving of indication.
rows.chinese_translation: 比丘说：“但居士，宫殿不适合给比丘住。”或其他类似的显露行为。

rows.pali: Parikathā nāma "bhikkhusaṅghassa senāsanaṃ sambādha"nti vacanaṃ, yā vā panaññāpi evarūpā pariyāyakathā.
rows.english: “Roundabout talk” is saying, “The resting place for the Community of Bhikkhus is crowded”; or any other such oblique talk.
rows.chinese_translation: “迂回说法”是说：“比丘僧团的住处很狭窄。”或其他类似的绕弯说法。

rows.pali: Bhesajje sabbampi vaṭṭati.
rows.english: 115. All, however, is allowed in the case of medicine.
rows.chinese_translation: 药物方面，一切方式都可以。

rows.pali: Tathā uppannaṃ pana bhesajjaṃ roge vūpasante paribhuñjituṃ vaṭṭati, na vaṭṭatīti.
rows.english: But when the disease is cured, is it or is it not allowed to use the medicine obtained in this way?
rows.chinese_translation: 那么，已经得到的药物，在疾病痊愈后还可以使用吗？

rows.pali: Tattha vinayadharā "bhagavatā dvāraṃ dinnaṃ, tasmā vaṭṭatī"ti vadanti.
rows.english: Herein, the Vinaya specialists say that the opening has been given by the Blessed One, therefore it is allowable.
rows.chinese_translation: 律学者说：“世尊已经开许，所以可以。”

rows.pali: Suttantikā pana "kiñcāpi āpatti na hoti, ājīvaṃ pana kopeti, tasmā na vaṭṭati"cceva vadanti.
rows.english: But the Suttanta specialists say that though there is no offence, nevertheless the livelihood is sullied, therefore it is not allowable.
rows.chinese_translation: 经学者则说：“虽然不构成犯戒，却会损害活命，因此不可以。”
rows.translation_note: sallekha-vutti 指极度简朴、避免任何诱导供养的生活方式。

rows.pali: Yo pana bhagavatā anuññātāpi nimittobhāsaparikathāviññattiyo akaronto appicchatādiguṇeyeva nissāya jīvitakkhayepi paccupaṭṭhite aññatreva obhāsādīhi uppannapaccaye paṭisevati, esa "paramasallekhavuttī"ti vuccati, seyyathāpi thero sāriputto.
rows.english: 116. But one who does not use hints, indications, roundabout talk, or intimation, though these are permitted by the Blessed One, and who depends only on the special qualities of fewness of wishes, etc., and makes use only of requisites obtained otherwise than by indication, etc., even when he thus risks his life, is called supreme in living in effacement, like the venerable Sāriputta.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果有人即使不使用世尊允许的暗示、显露、迂回说法和请求，只依少欲等功德生活；即使生命将尽，也只受用在暗示等之外所得的资具，这样的人称为“实行最上漏刻行者”，例如舍利弗长老。

rows.pali: So kirāyasmā ekasmiṃ samaye pavivekaṃ brūhayamāno mahāmoggallānattherena saddhiṃ aññatarasmiṃ araññe viharati, athassa ekasmiṃ divase udaravātābādho uppajjitvā atidukkhaṃ janesi.
rows.english: 117. It seems that the venerable one was cultivating seclusion at one time, living in a certain forest with the Elder Mahā Moggallāna. One day an affliction of colic arose in him, causing him great pain.
rows.chinese_translation: 据说，有一次尊者为了增长远离，和大目犍连长老住在某处森林；一天，他生起腹部风病，极其痛苦。

rows.pali: Mahāmoggallānatthero sāyanhasamaye tassāyasmato upaṭṭhānaṃ gato theraṃ nipannaṃ disvā taṃ pavattiṃ pucchitvā "pubbe te, āvuso, kena phāsu hotī"ti pucchi.
rows.english: In the evening the Elder Mahā Moggallāna went to attend upon him. Seeing him lying down, he asked what the reason was. And then he asked, “What used to make you better formerly, friend?”
rows.chinese_translation: 大目犍连长老傍晚去侍奉他，看见长老躺着，询问情况后问：“朋友，你从前靠什么会舒服些？”

rows.pali: Thero āha, "gihikāle me, āvuso, mātā sappimadhusakkarādīhi yojetvā asambhinnakhīrapāyāsaṃ adāsi, tena me phāsu ahosī"ti.
rows.english: The elder said, “When I was a layman, friend, my mother used to mix ghee, honey, sugar and so on, and give me rice gruel with pure milk. That used to make me better.”
rows.chinese_translation: 长老说：“朋友，我在家时，母亲会把酥油、蜂蜜、糖等调在未分离的乳粥里给我，我因此会舒服。”

rows.pali: Sopi āyasmā "hotu, āvuso, sace mayhaṃ vā tuyhaṃ vā puññaṃ atthi, appeva nāma sve labhissāmā"ti āha.
rows.english: Then the other said, “So be it, friend. If either you or I have merit, perhaps tomorrow we shall get some.”
rows.chinese_translation: 尊者说：“朋友，如果我或你有福德，明天也许能得到。”

rows.pali: Imaṃ pana nesaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ caṅkamanakoṭiyaṃ rukkhe adhivatthā devatā sutvā "sve ayyassa pāyāsaṃ uppādessāmī"ti tāvadeva therassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ gantvā jeṭṭhaputtassa sarīraṃ āvisitvā pīḷaṃ janesi.
rows.english: 118. Now, a deity who dwelt in a tree at the end of the walk overheard their conversation. [Thinking] “I will find rice gruel for the lord tomorrow,” he went meanwhile to the family who was supporting the elder and entered into the body of the eldest son, causing him discomfort.
rows.chinese_translation: 住在经行道尽头树上的天神听见他们的交谈，想“明天我要为长老生出乳粥”，便立即到长老侍者家，使长子身体发病。

rows.pali: Athassa tikicchānimittaṃ sannipatite ñātake āha – "sace sve therassa evarūpaṃ nāma pāyāsaṃ paṭiyādetha, taṃ muñcissāmī"ti.
rows.english: Then he told the assembled relatives the price of the cure: “If you prepare rice gruel of such a kind tomorrow for the elder, I will set this one free.”
rows.chinese_translation: 亲属聚集为他治疗时，天神说：“如果你们明天准备这种乳粥，我就让他痊愈。”

rows.pali: Te "tayā avuttepi mayaṃ therānaṃ nibaddhaṃ bhikkhaṃ demā"ti vatvā dutiyadivase tathārūpaṃ pāyāsaṃ paṭiyādiyiṃsu.
rows.english: They said: “Even without being told by you we regularly supply the elder’s needs,” and on the following day they prepared rice gruel of the kind needed.
rows.chinese_translation: 他们说：“即使你不说，我们也一直供养长老。”第二天便准备了那样的乳粥。

rows.pali: Mahāmoggallānatthero pātova āgantvā "āvuso, yāva ahaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā āgacchāmi, tāva idheva hohī"ti vatvā gāmaṃ pāvisi.
rows.english: 119.The Elder Mahā Moggallāna came in the morning and said, “Stay here, friend, till I come back from the alms round.” Then he went into the village.
rows.chinese_translation: 大目犍连长老一早来到，说：“朋友，在我行乞回来之前，你先留在这里。”然后进了村。

rows.pali: Te manussā paccuggantvā therassa pattaṃ gahetvā vuttappakārassa pāyāsassa pūretvā adaṃsu.
rows.english: Those people met him. They took his bowl, filled it with the stipulated kind of rice gruel, and gave it back to him.
rows.chinese_translation: 那些人迎上来，接过长老的钵，装满前述的乳粥交给他。

rows.pali: Thero gamanākāraṃ dassesi.
rows.english: The elder made as though to go,
rows.chinese_translation: 长老作出要离开的样子。

rows.pali: Te "bhuñjatha – bhante, tumhe, aparampi dassāmā"ti theraṃ bhojetvā puna pattapūraṃ adaṃsu.
rows.english: but they said, “Eat, venerable sir, we shall give you more.” When the elder had eaten, they gave him another bowlful.
rows.chinese_translation: 他们说：“尊者，请吃吧；我们还会再给。”于是请长老吃，又把钵装满交给他。

rows.pali: Thero gantvā "handāvuso sāriputta, paribhuñjā"ti upanāmesi.
rows.english: The elder left. Bringing the alms food to the venerable Sāriputta, he said, “Here, friend Sāriputta, eat.”
rows.chinese_translation: 长老回来，说：“舍利弗朋友，请受用。”

rows.pali: Theropi taṃ disvā "atimanāpo pāyāso, kathaṃ nu kho uppanno"ti cintento tassa uppattimūlaṃ disvā āha – "āvuso moggallāna, aparibhogāraho piṇḍapāto"ti.
rows.english: When the elder saw it, he thought, “The gruel is very nice. How was it got? ” and seeing how it had been obtained, he said, “Friend, the alms food cannot be used.”
rows.chinese_translation: 长老看见后想“乳粥真美味，但它是怎样得到的？”看见其来源后说：“目犍连朋友，这份食物不适合受用。”

rows.pali: Sopāyasmā "mādisena nāma ābhataṃ piṇḍapātaṃ na paribhuñjatī"ti cittampi anuppādetvā ekavacaneneva pattaṃ mukhavaṭṭiyaṃ gahetvā ekamante nikujjesi.
rows.english: 120. Instead of thinking, “He does not eat alms food brought by the likes of me,” the other at once took the bowl by the rim and turned it over on one side.
rows.chinese_translation: 尊者没有生起“像我这样的长老带来的食物竟不吃”的心，只用一句话捏住钵口，把钵倒扣在一旁。

rows.pali: Pāyāsassa saha bhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhānā therassa ābādho antaradhāyi, tato paṭṭhāya pañcacattālīsa vassāni na puna uppajji.
rows.english: As the rice gruel fell on the ground the elder’s affliction vanished. From then on it did not appear again during forty-five years.
rows.chinese_translation: 乳粥落地的同时，长老的病就消失了；从此以后四十五年不再发作。

rows.pali: Tato mahāmoggallānaṃ āha – "āvuso, vacīviññattiṃ nissāya uppanno pāyāso antesu nikkhamitvā bhūmiyaṃ carantesupi paribhuñjituṃ ayuttarūpo"ti.
rows.english: 121.Then he said to the venerable Mahā Moggallāna, “Friend, even if one’s bowels come out and trail on the ground, it is not fitting to eat gruel got by verbal intimation,”
rows.chinese_translation: 于是他对大目犍连说：“朋友，这乳粥是依靠语言请求而得到的；即使排出肠中而在地上爬行，也不适合受用。”

rows.pali: Imañca udānaṃ udānesi –
rows.english: and he uttered this exclamation:
rows.chinese_translation: 他还说了这首感叹偈：
rows.translation_note: “等首”即同一生命阶段完成修行并命终的分析。

rows.pali: "Vacīviññattivipphārā, uppannaṃ madhupāyasaṃ;
rows.english: The honey and the gruel obtained By influence of verbal hints
rows.chinese_translation: “因语言请求而得到的蜜乳粥，

rows.pali: Sace bhutto bhaveyyāhaṃ, sājīvo garahito mama.
rows.english: If I were to consent to eat My livelihood might well be blamed.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果我吃了，我的活命就会受到责备。

rows.pali: "Yadipi me antaguṇaṃ, nikkhamitvā bahi care;
rows.english: And even if my bowels obtrude And trail outside, and even though
rows.chinese_translation: 即使我的肠子排出体外，在外面爬行，

rows.pali: Neva bhindeyyaṃ ājīvaṃ, cajamānopi jīvitaṃ.
rows.english: My life is to be jeopardized, I will not blot my livelihood (Mil 370).
rows.chinese_translation: 我也不应破坏活命，哪怕因此舍弃生命。
rows.translation_note: 偈颂将语言请求所得的食物判为活命受责备。

rows.pali: "Ārādhemi sakaṃ cittaṃ, vivajjemi anesanaṃ;
rows.english: For I will satisfy my heart By shunning all wrong kinds of search;
rows.chinese_translation: 我使自己的心欢喜，避开不正当的寻找；

rows.pali: Nāhaṃ buddhappaṭikuṭṭhaṃ, kāhāmi ca anesana"nti.
rows.english: And never will I undertake The search the Buddhas have condemned.
rows.chinese_translation: 我不会做佛陀所斥责的不正当寻找。”

rows.pali: Ciragumbavāsikaambakhādakamahātissattheravatthupi cettha kathetabbaṃ.
rows.english: 122. And here too should be told the story of the Elder Mahā Tissa the Mango- eater who lived at Cīragumba32 (see §132 below).
rows.chinese_translation: 这里还应讲述长期住在灌木中的食芒果的大帝须长老的故事。

rows.pali: Evaṃ sabbathāpi.
rows.english: So in all respects:
rows.chinese_translation: 总之，无论何种情况，都应如此。

rows.pali: "Anesanāya cittampi, ajanetvā vicakkhaṇo;
rows.english: And, seeing clearly, give no thought To any search that is not good
rows.chinese_translation: “有智慧的出家修行者，不让心生起不正当寻找，

rows.pali: Ājīvaṃ parisodheyya, saddhāpabbajito yatī"ti.
rows.english: A man who has gone forth in faith Should purify his livelihood.
rows.chinese_translation: 应当清净自己的活命。”

rows.pali: Yathā ca vīriyena ājīvapārisuddhi, tathā paccayasannissitasīlaṃ paññāya sampādetabbaṃ.
rows.english: 123. (d) And as livelihood purification is to be undertaken by means of energy, so virtue dependent on requisites is to be undertaken by means of understanding.
rows.chinese_translation: 正如活命清净依靠精进成就，资具依止戒也应依靠智慧成就。

rows.pali: Paññāsādhanaṃ hi taṃ, paññavato paccayesu ādīnavānisaṃsadassanasamatthabhāvato.
rows.english: For that is accomplished by understanding, because one who possesses understanding is able to see the advantages and the dangers in requisites.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为它由智慧成就；有智慧的人能够看见资具的过患和利益。

rows.pali: Tasmā pahāya paccayagedhaṃ dhammena samena uppanne paccaye yathāvuttena vidhinā paññāya paccavekkhitvā paribhuñjantena sampādetabbaṃ.
rows.english: So one should abandon greed for requisites and undertake that virtue by using requisites obtained lawfully and properly, after reviewing them with understanding in the way aforesaid.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，应舍弃对资具的贪著；以正当、公平方式得到资具后，依照前述方法用智慧审察，再受用它来成就戒。
rows.translation_note: paccaya 的审察在获得与受用两个阶段分别进行。

rows.pali: Tattha duvidhaṃ paccavekkhaṇaṃ paccayānaṃ paṭilābhakāle, paribhogakāle ca.
rows.english: 124. Herein, reviewing is of two kinds: at the time of receiving requisites and at the time of using them.
rows.chinese_translation: 其中，对资具的审察有两种：获得资具时，以及受用资具时。

rows.pali: Paṭilābhakālepi hi dhātuvasena vā paṭikūlavasena vā paccavekkhitvā ṭhapitāni cīvarādīni tato uttari paribhuñjantassa anavajjova paribhogo, paribhogakālepi.
rows.english: For use (paribhoga) is blameless in one who at the time of receiving robes, etc., reviews them either as [mere] elements or as repulsive,33 and puts them aside for later use, and in one who reviews them thus at the time of using them.
rows.chinese_translation: 即使在获得时，依元素或不净来审察并存放衣物等；此后继续受用时，受用也是无过失的；受用时也同样。

rows.pali: Tatrāyaṃ sanniṭṭhānakaro vinicchayo –
rows.english: 125. Here is an explanation to settle the matter.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里作出结论性的判定：

rows.pali: Cattāro hi paribhogā theyyaparibhogo, iṇaparibhogo, dāyajjaparibhogo, sāmiparibhogoti.
rows.english: There are four kinds of use: use as theft,34 use as a debt? , use as an inheritance, use as a master.
rows.chinese_translation: 受用有四种：盗受用、负债受用、继承受用和主人受用。
rows.translation_note: 四种受用的分类按受用者的戒行和权利关系区分。

rows.pali: Tatra saṅghamajjhepi nisīditvā paribhuñjantassa dussīlassa paribhogo theyyaparibhogo nāma.
rows.english: Herein, use by one who is unvirtuous and makes use [of requisites], even sitting in the midst of the Community, is called “use as theft.”
rows.chinese_translation: 不持戒者即使坐在僧团中受用资具，也称为盗受用。

rows.pali: Sīlavato apaccavekkhitvā paribhogo iṇaparibhogo nāma.
rows.english: Use without reviewing by one who is virtuous is “use as a debt”;
rows.chinese_translation: 持戒者未经审察而受用，称为负债受用。

rows.pali: Tasmā cīvaraṃ paribhoge paribhoge paccavekkhitabbaṃ, piṇḍapāto ālope ālope, tathā asakkontena purebhattapacchābhattapurimayāmamajjhimayāmapacchimayāmesu.
rows.english: therefore the robe should be reviewed every time it is used, and the alms food lump by lump. One who cannot do this [should review it] before the meal, after the meal, in the first watch, in the middle watch, and in the last watch.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，袈裟应每次受用时审察；食物应每一口审察；若做不到，就应在早餐前、早餐后、初夜、中夜、后夜审察。

rows.pali: Sacassa apaccavekkhatova aruṇaṃ uggacchati, iṇaparibhogaṭṭhāne tiṭṭhati.
rows.english: If dawn breaks on him without his having reviewed it, he finds himself in the position of one who has used it as a debt.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果未作审察便日出，这种受用就属于负债受用。

rows.pali: Senāsanampi paribhoge paribhoge paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
rows.english: Also the resting place should be reviewed each time it is used.
rows.chinese_translation: 住处也应每次受用时审察。

rows.pali: Bhesajjassa paṭiggahaṇepi paribhogepi satipaccayatāva vaṭṭati.
rows.english: Recourse to mindfulness both in the accepting and the use of medicine is proper;
rows.chinese_translation: 药物无论接受还是受用，都必须依靠正念这一条件。

rows.pali: Evaṃ santepi paṭiggahaṇe satiṃ katvā paribhoge akarontasseva āpatti, paṭiggahaṇe pana satiṃ akatvā paribhoge karontassa anāpatti.
rows.english: but while this is so, though there is an offence for one who uses it without mindfulness after mindful acceptance, there is no offence for one who is mindful in using after accepting without mindfulness.
rows.chinese_translation: 即使如此，接受时有正念而受用时没有正念，才构成犯戒；接受时没有正念而受用时有正念，则不犯。
rows.translation_note: 四种清净中的“忏悔”是别解脱戒的传统译名，重点是犯戒后依律恢复清净。

rows.pali: Catubbidhā hi suddhi desanāsuddhi, saṃvarasuddhi, pariyeṭṭhisuddhi, paccavekkhaṇasuddhīti.
rows.english: 126. Purification is of four kinds: purification by the Teaching, purification by restraint, purification by search, and purification by reviewing.
rows.chinese_translation: 清净有四种：忏悔清净、防护清净、寻求清净和审察清净。

rows.pali: Tattha desanāsuddhi nāma pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlaṃ.
rows.english: Herein, virtue of the Pātimokkha restraint is called “purification by the Teaching”;
rows.chinese_translation: 其中，忏悔清净就是别解脱律仪戒。

rows.pali: Tañhi desanāya sujjhanato desanāsuddhīti vuccati.
rows.english: for that is so called because it purifies by means of teaching.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为它通过忏悔而清净，所以称为忏悔清净。

rows.pali: Saṃvarasuddhi nāma indriyasaṃvarasīlaṃ.
rows.english: Virtue of restraint of faculties is called “purification by restraint”;
rows.chinese_translation: 防护清净就是根律仪戒。

rows.pali: Tañhi "na puna evaṃ karissāmī"ti cittādhiṭṭhānasaṃvareneva sujjhanato saṃvarasuddhīti vuccati.
rows.english: for that is so called because it purifies by means of the restraint in the mental resolution, “I shall not do so again.”
rows.chinese_translation: 因为以“我不再这样做”的心念决意防护而清净，所以称为防护清净。

rows.pali: Pariyeṭṭhisuddhi nāma ājīvapārisuddhisīlaṃ.
rows.english: Virtue of livelihood purification is called “purification by search”;
rows.chinese_translation: 寻求清净就是活命清净戒。

rows.pali: Tañhi anesanaṃ pahāya dhammena samena paccaye uppādentassa pariyesanāya suddhattā pariyeṭṭhisuddhīti vuccati.
rows.english: for that is so called because search is purified in one who abandons wrong search and gets requisites lawfully and properly.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为舍弃不正当寻找，以正当、公平的方式获得资具，寻求本身清净，所以称为寻求清净。

rows.pali: Paccavekkhaṇasuddhi nāma paccayasannissitasīlaṃ.
rows.english: Virtue dependent on requisites is called “purification by reviewing”;
rows.chinese_translation: 审察清净就是资具依止戒。

rows.pali: Tañhi vuttappakārena paccavekkhaṇena sujjhanato paccavekkhaṇasuddhīti vuccati.
rows.english: for that is so called because it purifies by the reviewing of the kind already described.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为依照前面所说的方式审察而清净，所以称为审察清净。

rows.pali: Tena vuttaṃ "paṭiggahaṇe pana satiṃ akatvā paribhoge karontassa anāpattī"ti.
rows.english: Hence it was said above (§125): “There is no offence for one who is mindful in using after accepting without mindfulness.”
rows.chinese_translation: 因此经中说：“接受时没有正念而受用，则不犯戒。”

rows.pali: Sattannaṃ sekkhānaṃ paccayaparibhogo dāyajjaparibhogo nāma.
rows.english: 127. Use of the requisites by the seven kinds of trainers is called “use as an inheritance”;
rows.chinese_translation: 七位有学受用资具，称为继承受用。

rows.pali: Te hi bhagavato puttā, tasmā pitusantakānaṃ paccayānaṃ dāyādā hutvā te paccaye paribhuñjanti.
rows.english: for they are the Buddha’s sons, therefore they make use of the requisites as the heirs of requisites belonging to their father.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为他们是世尊的儿子，继承父亲所有的资具，所以受用这些资具。
rows.translation_note: “继承”是法的继承，不是世俗财产继承。

rows.pali: Kiṃpanete bhagavato paccaye paribhuñjanti, udāhu gihīnaṃ paccaye paribhuñjantīti.
rows.english: But how then, is it the Blessed One’s requisites or the laity’s requisites that are used?
rows.chinese_translation: 那么，他们受用的是世尊的资具，还是在家人的资具？

rows.pali: Gihīhi dinnāpi bhagavatā anuññātattā bhagavato santakā honti, tasmā bhagavato paccaye paribhuñjantīti veditabbā.
rows.english: Although given by the laity, they actually belong to the Blessed One, because it is by the Blessed One that they are permitted. That is why it should be understood that the Blessed One’s requisites are used.
rows.chinese_translation: 虽然资具由在家人供给，但因世尊允许，便成为世尊所有；因此应知他们受用的是世尊的资具。

rows.pali: Dhammadāyādasuttañcettha sādhakaṃ.
rows.english: The confirmation here is in the Dhammadāyāda Sutta (MN 3).
rows.chinese_translation: 这里，《法继承者经》可以作为证明。

rows.pali: Khīṇāsavānaṃ paribhogo sāmiparibhogo nāma.
rows.english: Use by those whose cankers are destroyed is called “use as a master”;
rows.chinese_translation: 漏尽者的受用，称为主人受用。

rows.pali: Te hi taṇhāya dāsabyaṃ atītattā sāmino hutvā paribhuñjanti.
rows.english: for they make use of them as masters because they have escaped the slavery of craving.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为他们已经超越贪爱的奴役，成为主人而受用。

rows.pali: Imesu paribhogesu sāmiparibhogo ca dāyajjaparibhogo ca sabbesaṃ vaṭṭati.
rows.english: 128. As regards these kinds of use, use as a master and use as an inheritance are allowable for all.
rows.chinese_translation: 在这些受用中，主人受用和继承受用适用于所有人。

rows.pali: Iṇaparibhogo na vaṭṭati.
rows.english: Use as a debt is not allowable,
rows.chinese_translation: 负债受用不适用。

rows.pali: Theyyaparibhoge kathāyeva natthi.
rows.english: to say nothing of use as theft.
rows.chinese_translation: 关于盗受用，根本没有讨论的余地。
rows.translation_note: 无负债受用与继承受用的归类是两种分析角度。

rows.pali: Yo panāyaṃ sīlavato paccavekkhitaparibhogo, so iṇaparibhogassa paccanīkattā āṇaṇyaparibhogo vā hoti, dāyajjaparibhogeyeva vā saṅgahaṃ gacchati.
rows.english: But this use of what is reviewed by one who is virtuous is use freed from debt because it is the opposite of use as a debt or is included in use as an inheritance too.
rows.chinese_translation: 持戒者经过审察而受用，因为与负债受用相反，所以是无负债受用；或者可以归入继承受用。

rows.pali: Sīlavāpi hi imāya sikkhāya samannāgatattā sekkhotveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
rows.english: For one possessed of virtue is called a trainer too because of possessing this training.
rows.chinese_translation: 持戒者由于具足这一学处，仍然被归为有学者。

rows.pali: Imesu pana paribhogesu yasmā sāmiparibhogo aggo, tasmā taṃ patthayamānena bhikkhunā vuttappakārāya paccavekkhaṇāya paccavekkhitvā paribhuñjantena paccayasannissitasīlaṃ sampādetabbaṃ.
rows.english: 129. As regards these three kinds of use, since use as a master is best, when a bhikkhu undertakes virtue dependent on requisites, he should aspire to that and use them after reviewing them in the way described.
rows.chinese_translation: 在这些受用中，因为主人受用最高，比丘希望达到它，就应依前述方式审察后受用资具，以成就资具依止戒。

rows.pali: Evaṃ karonto hi kiccakārī hoti.
rows.chinese_translation: 这样做的人，就是履行职责的人。

rows.pali: Vuttampi cetaṃ –
rows.english: And this is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 经中也说：

rows.pali: "Piṇḍaṃ vihāraṃ sayanāsanañca,
rows.english: Of alms food, and of dwelling, And of a resting place,
rows.chinese_translation: “食物、住处、床座，

rows.pali: Āpañca saṅghāṭirajūpavāhanaṃ;
rows.english: And also of the water For washing dirt from robes”
rows.chinese_translation: 水，以及洗去僧衣尘垢的用品；

rows.pali: Sutvāna dhammaṃ sugatena desitaṃ,
rows.english: Who listens to the Dhamma As taught by the Sublime One
rows.chinese_translation: 听闻善逝所说的法后，
rows.translation_note: “洗去僧衣尘垢”对应 saṅghāṭirajūpavāhana 的资具功能。

rows.pali: Saṅkhāya seve varapaññasāvako.
rows.english: The truly wise disciple Makes use, after reviewing (Sn 391).
rows.chinese_translation: 智慧最上等的弟子审察而受用。”

rows.pali: "Tasmā hi piṇḍe sayanāsane ca,
rows.english: By alms food, [and by dwelling,] And by a resting place,
rows.chinese_translation: “因此，对于食物、床座，

rows.pali: Āpe ca saṅghāṭirajūpavāhane;
rows.english: And also by the water For washing dirt from robes”
rows.chinese_translation: 对于水和洗去僧衣尘垢的用品，

rows.pali: Etesu dhammesu anūpalitto,
rows.english: unsullied By any of these matters,
rows.chinese_translation: 比丘不染著这些事物，

rows.pali: Bhikkhu yathā pokkhare vāribindu. (su. ni. 393-394);
rows.english: A bhikkhu is like a drop of water Lying on leaves of lotus,(Sn 392).
rows.chinese_translation: 如水滴不沾莲花。”

rows.pali: "Kālena laddhā parato anuggahā,
rows.english: “Since aid it is and timely Procured from another
rows.chinese_translation: “按时得到的、从他人处获得的资具，

rows.pali: Khajjesu bhojjesu ca sāyanesu ca;
rows.english: In chewing and in eating, In tasting food besides:
rows.chinese_translation: 无论是吃的、喝的或晚间食物，

rows.pali: Mattaṃ sa jaññā satataṃ upaṭṭhito,
rows.english: The right amount he reckons, Mindful without remitting
rows.chinese_translation: 他应当始终知道适量，并保持正念，

rows.pali: Vaṇassa ālepanarūhane yathā.
rows.english: He treats it as an ointment Applied upon a wound.” (Source untraced)
rows.chinese_translation: 如同为伤口涂药使它愈合。”
rows.translation_note: 譬喻强调食物只用于维持生命，不以贪著为目的。

rows.pali: "Kantāre puttamaṃsaṃva, akkhassabbhañjanaṃ yathā;
rows.english: “So like the child’s flesh in the desert Like the greasing for the axle,
rows.chinese_translation: “如穿越旷野时食用孩子的肉，如给车轴上油；

rows.pali: Evaṃ āhāre āhāraṃ, yāpanatthamamucchito"ti.
rows.english: He should eat without delusion Nutriment to keep alive.” (Source untraced)
rows.chinese_translation: 同样，他不迷恋食物，只为了维持生命而受用食物。”

rows.pali: Imassa ca paccayasannissitasīlassa paripūrakāritāya bhāgineyyasaṅgharakkhitasāmaṇerassa vatthu kathetabbaṃ.
rows.english: 130. And in connection with the fulfilling of this virtue dependent on requisites there should be told the story of the novice Saṅgharakkhita the Nephew.
rows.chinese_translation: 关于充分实行资具依止戒，还应讲述外甥僧护沙弥的故事。

rows.pali: So hi sammā paccavekkhitvā paribhuñji.
rows.english: For he made use of requisites after reviewing,
rows.chinese_translation: 他确实是在正确审察后才受用资具。

rows.pali: Yathāha –
rows.english: according as it is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 经中说：

rows.pali: "Upajjhāyo maṃ bhuñjamānaṃ, sālikūraṃ sunibbutaṃ;
rows.english: “Seeing me eat a dish of rice Quite cold, my preceptor observed:
rows.chinese_translation: “导师看见我吃冷却得很好的萨利米饭，
rows.translation_note: sālikūra 是萨利米等谷物煮成的饭；故事用于说明饮食时的正念。

rows.pali: Mā heva tvaṃ sāmaṇera, jivhaṃ jhāpesi asaññato.
rows.english: ‘Novice, if you are not restrained, Be careful not to burn your tongue.’
rows.chinese_translation: 说：‘沙弥啊，你可千万别无知地烧伤自己的舌头。’”

rows.pali: "Upajjhāyassa vaco sutvā, saṃvegamalabhiṃ tadā;
rows.english: On hearing my Preceptor’s words, I then and there felt urged to act
rows.chinese_translation: “听到导师的话，我当时生起了悚惧；

rows.pali: Ekāsane nisīditvā, arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.
rows.english: And, sitting in a single session, I reached the goal of Arahantship.
rows.chinese_translation: 我坐在一个座位上，便证得阿罗汉果。

rows.pali: "Sohaṃ paripuṇṇasaṅkappo, cando pannaraso yathā;
rows.english: Since I am now waxed full in thought Like the full moon of the fifteenth (M III 277),
rows.chinese_translation: 那时我的愿望已经圆满，像十五的月亮；

rows.pali: Sabbāsavaparikkhīṇo, natthi dāni punabbhavo"ti.
rows.english: And all my cankers are destroyed, There is no more becoming now.”
rows.chinese_translation: 一切漏尽，如今已没有再生。”

rows.pali: "Tasmā aññopi dukkhassa, patthayanto parikkhayaṃ;
rows.english: And so should any other man Aspiring to end suffering
rows.chinese_translation: “因此，若有人希望彻底灭尽痛苦，

rows.pali: Yoniso paccavekkhitvā, paṭisevetha paccaye"ti.
rows.english: Make use of all the requisites Wisely after reviewing them.
rows.chinese_translation: 应当如理审察后受用资具。”

rows.pali: Evaṃ pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlādivasena catubbidhaṃ.
rows.english: So virtue is of four kinds as “virtue of Pātimokkha restraint,” and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 这样，戒依别解脱律仪等分为四种。

rows.pali: 20.Pañcavidhakoṭṭhāsassa paṭhamapañcake anupasampannasīlādivasena attho veditabbo.
rows.english: 131. 18. In the first pentad in the fivefold section the meaning should be understood in accordance with the virtue of those not fully admitted to the Order, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 在五种分类的第一组中，应依未受具足戒者等理解其意义。

rows.pali: Vuttañhetaṃ paṭisambhidāyaṃ –
rows.english: For this is said in the Paṭisambhidā:
rows.chinese_translation: 《无碍解道》中说：

rows.pali: "Katamaṃ pariyantapārisuddhisīlaṃ?
rows.english: “(a) What is virtue consisting in limited purification?
rows.chinese_translation: “什么是有限清净戒？

rows.pali: Anupasampannānaṃ pariyantasikkhāpadānaṃ, idaṃ pariyantapārisuddhisīlaṃ.
rows.english: That of the training precepts for those not fully admitted to the Order: such is virtue consisting in limited purification.
rows.chinese_translation: 未受具足戒者的有限学处，就是有限清净戒。

rows.pali: Katamaṃ apariyantapārisuddhisīlaṃ?
rows.english: (b) What is virtue consisting in unlimited purification?
rows.chinese_translation: 什么是无限清净戒？

rows.pali: Upasampannānaṃ apariyantasikkhāpadānaṃ, idaṃ apariyantapārisuddhisīlaṃ.
rows.english: That of the training precepts for those fully admitted to the Order: such is virtue consisting in unlimited purification.
rows.chinese_translation: 受具足戒者的无限学处，就是无限清净戒。

rows.pali: Katamaṃ paripuṇṇapārisuddhisīlaṃ?
rows.english: (c) What is virtue consisting in fulfilled purification?
rows.chinese_translation: 什么是圆满清净戒？

rows.pali: Puthujjanakalyāṇakānaṃ kusaladhamme yuttānaṃ sekkhapariyante paripūrakārīnaṃ kāye ca jīvite ca anapekkhānaṃ pariccattajīvitānaṃ, idaṃ paripuṇṇapārisuddhisīlaṃ.
rows.english: That of magnanimous ordinary men devoted to profitable things, who are perfecting [the course] that ends in trainership, regardless of the physical body and life, having given up [attachment to] life: such is virtue of fulfilled purification,
rows.chinese_translation: 善凡夫中修善法、实行有学戒的圆满者，不顾惜身体和生命、舍弃生命者的戒，就是圆满清净戒。
rows.translation_note: paripuṇṇa-pārisuddhi 侧重有学戒圆满、无垢并作为果位近因。

rows.pali: Katamaṃ aparāmaṭṭhapārisuddhisīlaṃ?
rows.english: (d) What is virtue consisting in purification not adhered to?
rows.chinese_translation: 什么是不取著清净戒？

rows.pali: Sattannaṃ sekkhānaṃ, idaṃ aparāmaṭṭhapārisuddhisīlaṃ.
rows.english: That of the seven kinds of trainer: such is virtue consisting in purification not adhered to.
rows.chinese_translation: 七位有学的戒，就是不取著清净戒。

rows.pali: Katamaṃ paṭippassaddhipārisuddhisīlaṃ?
rows.english: (e) What is virtue consisting in tranquillized purification?
rows.chinese_translation: 什么是寂静清净戒？

rows.pali: Tathāgatasāvakānaṃ khīṇāsavānaṃ paccekabuddhānaṃ tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ, idaṃ paṭippassaddhipārisuddhisīla"nti (paṭi. ma. 1.37).
rows.english: That of the Perfect One’s disciples with cankers destroyed, of the Paccekabuddhas, of the Perfect Ones, accomplished and fully enlightened: such is virtue consisting in tranquillized purification” (Paṭis I 42–43).
rows.chinese_translation: 如来弟子中的漏尽者、辟支佛、如来、阿罗汉、正等正觉者的戒，就是寂静清净戒。”

rows.pali: Tattha anupasampannānaṃ sīlaṃ gaṇanavasena sapariyantattā pariyantapārisuddhisīlanti veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: 132. (a) Herein, the virtue of those not fully admitted to the Order should be understood as virtue consisting in limited purification, because it is limited by the number [of training precepts, that is, five or eight or ten].
rows.chinese_translation: 其中，未受具足戒者的戒因数量有界限，所以应知称为有限清净戒。

rows.pali: Upasampannānaṃ –
rows.english: (b) That of those fully admitted to the Order is [describable] thus:
rows.chinese_translation: 至于受具足戒者：

rows.pali: "Nava koṭisahassāni, asītisatakoṭiyo;
rows.english: Nine thousand millions, and a hundred And eighty millions then as well,
rows.chinese_translation: “九十亿，八十亿百，

rows.pali: Paññāsasatasahassāni, chattiṃsā ca punāpare.
rows.english: And fifty plus a hundred thousand, And thirty-six again to swell.
rows.chinese_translation: 五十亿百，还有三十六；

rows.pali: "Ete saṃvaravinayā, sambuddhena pakāsitā;
rows.english: The total restraint disciplines: These rules the Enlightened One explains
rows.chinese_translation: 这些是正等觉者宣说的防护律，

rows.pali: Peyyālamukhena niddiṭṭhā, sikkhā vinayasaṃvare"ti. –
rows.english: Told under heads for filling out, Which the Discipline restraint contains.35
rows.note: 35. The figures depend on whether koṭi is taken as 1,000,000 or 100,000 or 10,000.
rows.chinese_translation: 以省略的方式说明律藏中的学处。”

rows.pali: Evaṃ gaṇanavasena sapariyantampi anavasesavasena samādānabhāvañca lābhayasañātiaṅgajīvitavasena adiṭṭhapariyantabhāvañca sandhāya apariyantapārisuddhisīlanti vuttaṃ, ciragumbavāsikaambakhādakamahātissattherassa sīlamiva.
rows.english: So although limited in number, it should yet be understood as virtue consisting in unlimited purification, since it is undertaken without reserve and has no obvious limit such as gain, fame, relatives, limbs or life. Like the virtue of the Elder Mahā Tissa the Mango-eater who lived at Cīragumba (see §122 above).
rows.chinese_translation: 这是从数量有限、受持时不遗留任何部分，以及不以利得、名誉、亲族、身体和生命为限等意义上，说为无限清净戒；正如长期住在灌木中、食芒果的大帝须长老的戒。
rows.translation_note: 数字偈颂的具体数量依律藏分类，此处保持原有省略式表达。

rows.pali: Tathā hi so āyasmā –
rows.english: 133. For that venerable one never abandoned the following good man’s recollection:
rows.chinese_translation: 因为那位尊者说：

rows.pali: "Dhanaṃ caje aṅgavarassa hetu, aṅgaṃ caje jīvitaṃ rakkhamāno;
rows.english: “Wealth for a sound limb’s sake should be renounced, And one who guards his life gives up his limbs;
rows.chinese_translation: “为了钱财，舍弃身体最重要的部分；为了保护生命，舍弃肢体；

rows.pali: Aṅgaṃ dhanaṃ jīvitañcāpi sabbaṃ, caje naro dhammamanussaranto"ti. –
rows.english: And wealth and limbs and life, each one of these, A man gives up who practices the Dhamma.”
rows.chinese_translation: 忆念正法的人，连肢体、财富和生命，也都应舍弃。”

rows.pali: Imaṃ sappurisānussatiṃ avijahanto jīvitasaṃsayepi sikkhāpadaṃ avītikkamma tadeva apariyantapārisuddhisīlaṃ nissāya upāsakassa piṭṭhigatova arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
rows.english: And he never transgressed a training precept even when his life was in the balance, and in this way he reached Arahantship with that same virtue of unlimited purification as his support while he was being carried on a lay devotee’s back.
rows.chinese_translation: 他不舍弃对善人的这种忆念，即使生命处于危险，也不违犯学处；依靠这种无限清净戒，他紧随在家人身后证得阿罗汉果。

rows.pali: Yathāha –
rows.english: According to as it is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 经中说：

rows.pali: "Na pitā napi te mātā, na ñāti napi bandhavo;
rows.english: “Nor your mother nor your father Nor your relatives and kin
rows.chinese_translation: “不是父亲、母亲，也不是亲族或朋友，
rows.translation_note: piṭṭhigata 的字面是“跟在背后”，叙述依止在家人而证果。

rows.pali: Karotetādisaṃ kiccaṃ, sīlavantassa kāraṇā.
rows.english: Have done as much as this for you Because you are possessed of virtue.”
rows.chinese_translation: 会因持戒者而做出这样的事业。

rows.pali: Saṃvegaṃ janayitvāna, sammasitvāna yoniso;
rows.english: So, stirred with urgency, and wisely Comprehending36 with insight,
rows.note: 36. “Comprehending” (sammasana) is a technical term that will become clear in Chapter XX. In short, it is inference that generalizes the “th...
rows.chinese_translation: 生起悚惧，如理审察，

rows.pali: Tassa piṭṭhigato santo, arahattaṃ apāpuṇī"ti.
rows.english: While carried on his helper’s back He reached the goal of Arahantship.
rows.chinese_translation: 他安住在那人身后，证得阿罗汉果。”

rows.pali: Puthujjanakalyāṇakānaṃ sīlaṃ upasampadato paṭṭhāya sudhotajātimaṇi viya suparikammakatasuvaṇṇaṃ viya ca atiparisuddhattā cittuppādamattakenapi malena virahitaṃ arahattasseva padaṭṭhānaṃ hoti, tasmā paripuṇṇapārisuddhīti vuccati, mahāsaṅgharakkhitabhāgineyyasaṅgharakkhitattherānaṃ viya.
rows.english: 134. (c) The magnanimous ordinary man’s virtue, which from the time of admission to the Order is devoid even of the stain of a [wrong] thought because of its extreme purity, like a gem of purest water, like well-refined gold, becomes the proximate cause for Arahantship itself, which is why it is called consisting of fulfilled purification; like that of the lders Saṅgharakkhita the Great and Saṅgharakkhita the Nephew.
rows.chinese_translation: 善凡夫的戒，从受具足戒开始，因为极其清净，像洗净的宝石、精工磨炼的黄金；哪怕只有一个心念也没有污垢，并且正是阿罗汉果的近因，所以称为圆满清净戒，如大护僧长老和外甥僧护长老的戒。

rows.pali: Mahāsaṅgharakkhitattheraṃ kira atikkantasaṭṭhivassaṃ maraṇamañce nipannaṃ bhikkhusaṅgho lokuttarādhigamaṃ pucchi.
rows.english: 135. The Elder Saṅgharakkhita the Great (Mahā Saṅgharakkhita), aged over sixty, was lying, it seems, on his deathbed. The Order of Bhikkhus questioned him about attainment of the supramundane state.
rows.chinese_translation: 据说，大护僧长老年过六十，躺在临终床上，僧团问他是否证得出世间法。

rows.pali: Thero "natthi me lokuttaradhammo"ti āha.
rows.english: The elder said: “I have no supramundane state.”
rows.chinese_translation: 长老说：“我没有出世间法。”

rows.pali: Athassa upaṭṭhāko daharabhikkhu āha – "bhante, tumhe parinibbutāti samantā dvādasayojanā manussā sannipatitā, tumhākaṃ puthujjanakālakiriyāya mahājanassa vippaṭisāro bhavissatī"ti.
rows.english: Then the young bhikkhu who was attending on him said: “Venerable sir, people have come as much as twelve leagues, thinking that you have reached Nibbāna. It will be a disappointment for many if you die as an ordinary man.”
rows.chinese_translation: 他的年轻侍者比丘说：“尊者，您即将般涅槃，方圆十二由旬的人都聚集来了；如果您以凡夫身份命终，大众会悔恨。”

rows.pali: Āvuso, ahaṃ "metteyyaṃ bhagavantaṃ passissāmī"ti na vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapesiṃ.
rows.english: — “Friend, thinking to see the Blessed One Metteyya, I did not try for insight.
rows.chinese_translation: 长老说：“朋友，我一直没有修观，只想着‘我要见弥勒世尊’。”
rows.translation_note: 长老先以谦称否认出世间法，后在临终前迅速修行证果。

rows.pali: Tena hi maṃ nisīdāpetvā okāsaṃ karohīti.
rows.english: So help me to sit up and give me the chance.”
rows.chinese_translation: “那么请扶我坐起来，给我一个机会。”

rows.pali: So theraṃ nisīdāpetvā bahi nikkhanto.
rows.english: He helped the elder to sit up and went out.
rows.chinese_translation: 他扶长老坐起后，便走到外面。

rows.pali: Thero tassa saha nikkhamanāva arahattaṃ patvā accharikāya saññaṃ adāsi.
rows.english: As he went out the elder reached Arahantship and he gave a sign by snapping his fingers.
rows.chinese_translation: 长老就在他出去的同时证得阿罗汉果，并以弹指声示意。

rows.pali: Saṅgho sannipatitvā āha – "bhante, evarūpe maraṇakāle lokuttaradhammaṃ nibbattentā dukkaraṃ karitthā"ti.
rows.english: The Order assembled and said to him: “Venerable sir, you have done a difficult thing in achieving the supramundane state in the hour of death.”
rows.chinese_translation: 僧团聚集后说：“尊者，在这样的临终时刻生起出世间法，您做了难事。”

rows.pali: Nāvuso etaṃ dukkaraṃ, apica vo dukkaraṃ ācikkhissāmi – "ahaṃ, āvuso, pabbajitakālato paṭṭhāya asatiyā aññāṇapakataṃ kammaṃ nāma na passāmī"ti.
rows.english: —“That was not difficult, friends. But rather I will tell you what is difficult. Friends, I see no action done [by me] without mindfulness and unknowingly since the time I went forth.”
rows.chinese_translation: “朋友，这不算难；我告诉你们真正难的事：朋友，自从我出家以来，我从未见过有哪件行为是在失念和无知中做的。”

rows.pali: Bhāgineyyopissa paññāsavassakāle evameva arahattaṃ pāpuṇīti.
rows.english: His nephew also reached Arahantship in the same way at the age of fifty years.
rows.chinese_translation: 他的外甥在五十岁时也同样证得阿罗汉果。

rows.pali: "Appassutopi ce hoti, sīlesu asamāhito;
rows.english: 136. “Now, if a man has little learning And he is careless of his virtue,
rows.chinese_translation: “即使听闻很少，且不安住于戒；
rows.translation_note: 本条偈颂在下一批继续。

rows.pali: Ubhayena naṃ garahanti, sīlato ca sutena ca.
rows.english: They censure him on both accounts For lack of virtue and of learning.
rows.chinese_translation: 也不会同时因戒行和听闻而受到责备。”

rows.pali: "Appassutopi ce hoti, sīlesu susamāhito;
rows.english: “But if he is of little learning Yet he is careful of his virtue,
rows.chinese_translation: “即使听闻很少，只要善于安住于戒；

rows.pali: Sīlato naṃ pasaṃsanti, tassa sampajjate sutaṃ.
rows.english: They praise him for his virtue, so It is as though he too had learning.
rows.chinese_translation: 人们会因他的戒而称赞他，他的听闻也会因此成就。

rows.pali: "Bahussutopi ce hoti, sīlesu asamāhito;
rows.english: “And if he is of ample learning Yet he is careless of his virtue,
rows.chinese_translation: 即使听闻很多，却不安住于戒；

rows.pali: Sīlato naṃ garahanti, nāssa sampajjate sutaṃ.
rows.english: They blame him for his virtue, so It is as though he had no learning.
rows.chinese_translation: 人们会因他的戒而责备他，他的听闻也不会因此成就。

rows.pali: "Bahussutopi ce hoti, sīlesu susamāhito;
rows.english: “But if he is of ample learning And he is careful of his virtue,
rows.chinese_translation: 即使听闻很多，又善于安住于戒；

rows.pali: Ubhayena naṃ pasaṃsanti, sīlato ca sutena ca.
rows.english: They give him praise on both accounts For virtue and as well for learning.
rows.chinese_translation: 人们会同时因他的戒和听闻而称赞他。

rows.pali: "Bahussutaṃ dhammadharaṃ, sappaññaṃ buddhasāvakaṃ;
rows.english: “The Buddha’s pupil of much learning Who keeps the Law with understanding—
rows.chinese_translation: “多闻、持法、有智慧的佛弟子，
rows.translation_note: 阎浮金是南赡部洲的优质黄金譬喻，强调清净无垢。

rows.pali: Nekkhaṃ jambonadasseva, ko taṃ ninditumarahati;
rows.english: A jewel of Jambu River gold37 Who is here fit to censure him?
rows.note: 37. A story of the Jambu River and its gold is given at M-a IV 147.
rows.chinese_translation: 如阎浮金般纯净，谁有资格责备他？

rows.pali: Devāpi naṃ pasaṃsanti, brahmunāpi pasaṃsito"ti. (a. ni. 4.6);
rows.english: Deities praise him [constantly], By Brahmā also is he praised (A II 7).
rows.chinese_translation: 诸天也称赞他，梵天也赞叹他。”

rows.pali: Sekkhānaṃ pana sīlaṃ diṭṭhivasena aparāmaṭṭhattā, puthujjanānaṃ vā pana rāgavasena aparāmaṭṭhasīlaṃ aparāmaṭṭhapārisuddhīti veditabbaṃ, kuṭumbiyaputtatissattherassa sīlaṃ viya.
rows.english: 137. (d) What should be understood as virtue consisting in purification not adhered to is trainers’ virtue, because it is not adhered to by [false] view, and ordinary men’s virtue when not adhered to by greed. Like the virtue of the Elder Tissa the Landowner’s Son (Kuṭumbiyaputta-Tissa-thera).
rows.chinese_translation: 有学的戒，因为不被邪见执取；凡夫善者的戒，因为不被贪爱执取，称为不取著清净戒，如居士子帝须长老的戒。
rows.translation_note: aparāmaṭṭha 同时排除邪见和贪爱两类执取。

rows.pali: So hi āyasmā tathārūpaṃ sīlaṃ nissāya arahatte patiṭṭhātukāmo verike āha –
rows.english: Wanting to become established in Arahantship in dependence on such virtue, this venerable one told his enemies:
rows.chinese_translation: 他希望依靠那样的戒安住于阿罗汉果，于是对敌人说：

rows.pali: "Ubho pādāni bhinditvā, saññapessāmi vo ahaṃ;
rows.english: I broke the bones of both my legs To give the pledge you asked from me.
rows.chinese_translation: “我打断双脚，让你们知道；

rows.pali: Aṭṭiyāmi harāyāmi, sarāgamaraṇaṃ aha"nti.
rows.english: I am revolted and ashamed At death accompanied by greed.
rows.chinese_translation: 我痛苦而羞惭，因为我正面临带着贪爱的死亡。”

rows.pali: "Evāhaṃ cintayitvāna, sammasitvāna yoniso;
rows.english: “And after I had thought on this, And wisely then applied insight,
rows.chinese_translation: “我这样思惟，如理审察；

rows.pali: Sampatte aruṇuggamhi, arahattaṃ apāpuṇi"nti. (dī. ni. aṭṭha. 2.373);
rows.english: When the sun rose and shone on me, I had become an Arahant” (M-a I 233).
rows.chinese_translation: 黎明到来时，我便证得阿罗汉果。”

rows.pali: Aññataropi mahāthero bāḷhagilāno sahatthā āhārampi paribhuñjituṃ asakkonto sake muttakarīse palipanno samparivattati, taṃ disvā aññataro daharo "aho dukkhā jīvitasaṅkhārā"ti āha.
rows.english: 138. Also there was a certain senior elder who was very ill and unable to eat with his own hand. He was writhing smeared with his own urine and excrement. Seeing him, a certain young bhikkhu said, “Oh, what a painful process life is!”
rows.chinese_translation: 另有一位大长老病得很重，连亲手吃饭也做不到，倒卧在自己的尿粪中；一位年轻比丘看见后说：“生命行实在苦啊！”

rows.pali: Tamenaṃ mahāthero āha – "ahaṃ, āvuso, idāni miyyamāno saggasampattiṃ labhissāmi, natthi me ettha saṃsayo, imaṃ pana sīlaṃ bhinditvā laddhasampatti nāma sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya paṭiladdhagihibhāvasadisī"ti vatvā "sīleneva saddhiṃ marissāmī"ti tattheva nipanno tameva rogaṃ sammasanto arahattaṃ patvā bhikkhusaṅghassa imāhi gāthāhi byākāsi –
rows.english: The senior elder told him: “If I were to die now, friend, I should obtain the bliss of heaven; I have no doubt of that. But the bliss obtained by breaking this virtue would be like the lay state obtained by disavowing the training,” and he added: “I shall die together with my virtue.” As he lay there, he comprehended that same illness [with insight], and he reached Arahantship. Having done so, he pronounced these verses to the Order of Bhikkhus:
rows.chinese_translation: 大长老说：“朋友，我现在临终，必能获得天界成就，对此没有疑问；但若破坏这戒而获得成就，就像舍弃学处后重新成为在家人一样。”说完“我要与戒一起死去”，便躺在那里审察同一疾病，证得阿罗汉果，并以偈颂向僧团宣告：
rows.translation_note: 长老以不破戒为原则，即使天界成就也不以破戒换取。

rows.pali: "Phuṭṭhassa me aññatarena byādhinā,
rows.english: “I am victim of a sickening disease
rows.chinese_translation: “我被某种疾病触及，

rows.pali: Rogena bāḷhaṃ dukhitassa ruppato;
rows.english: That racks me with its burden of cruel pain;
rows.chinese_translation: 因病苦而剧烈痛楚、身体受损；

rows.pali: Parisussati khippamidaṃ kaḷevaraṃ,
rows.english: So this my corpse will soon have withered up
rows.chinese_translation: 这个身体很快就会干枯，

rows.pali: Pupphaṃ yathā paṃsuni ātape kataṃ.
rows.english: As flowers in the dust burnt by the sun.
rows.chinese_translation: 如同置于阳光下尘土中的花朵。

rows.pali: "Ajaññaṃ jaññasaṅkhātaṃ, asuciṃ sucisammataṃ;
rows.english: “Unbeautiful called beautiful, Unclean while reckoned as if clean,
rows.chinese_translation: “把非人的东西当作人，把不净的东西当作清净；

rows.pali: Nānākuṇapaparipūraṃ, jaññarūpaṃ apassato.
