rows.english: Though full of ordure seeming fair To him that cannot see it clear.
rows.chinese_translation: 看不见由各种尸体充满的、呈现为人的身体。

rows.pali: "Dhiratthu maṃ āturaṃ pūtikāyaṃ, duggandhiyaṃ asuci byādhidhammaṃ;
rows.english: “So out upon this ailing rotting body, Fetid and filthy, punished with affliction,
rows.chinese_translation: “愿这个病苦、腐败、恶臭、不净、必然生病的身体受到诅咒；
rows.translation_note: “非人、人；不净、清净”是对身体错误认知的对照。

rows.pali: Yatthappamattā adhimucchitā pajā, hāpenti maggaṃ sugatūpapattiyā"ti.
rows.english: Doting on which this silly generation Has lost the way to be reborn in heaven! ” (J-a II 437)
rows.chinese_translation: 众生沉迷并迷醉于它，

rows.pali: Arahantādīnaṃ pana sīlaṃ sabbadarathappaṭippassaddhiyā parisuddhattā paṭippassaddhipārisuddhīti veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: 139. (e) It is the virtue of the Arahants, etc., that should be understood as tranquillized purification, because of tranquillization of all disturbance and because of purifiedness.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此错失通往善趣的道路。”

rows.pali: Evaṃ pariyantapārisuddhiādivasena pañcavidhaṃ.
rows.english: So it is of five kinds as “consisting in limited purification,” and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 阿罗汉等人的戒，因为一切动摇都已寂静、极其清净，应知称为寂静清净戒。

rows.pali: Dutiyapañcake pāṇātipātādīnaṃ pahānādivasena attho veditabbo.
rows.english: 40. 19. In the second pentad the meaning should be understood as the abandoning, etc., of killing living things, etc.;
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，戒依有限清净等分为五种。

rows.pali: Vuttañhetaṃ paṭisambhidāyaṃ –
rows.english: for this is said in the Paṭisambhidā:
rows.chinese_translation: 在第二组五分中，应依舍弃杀生等来理解意义。

rows.pali: "Pañca sīlāni pāṇātipātassa pahānaṃ sīlaṃ, veramaṇī sīlaṃ, cetanā sīlaṃ, saṃvaro sīlaṃ, avītikkamo sīlaṃ.
rows.english: “Five kinds of virtue: (1) In the case of killing living things, (a) abandoning is virtue, (b) abstention is virtue, (c) volition is virtue, (d) restraint is virtue, (e) non- transgression is virtue.
rows.chinese_translation: 《无碍解道》中说：

rows.pali: Adinnādānassa, kāmesumicchācārassa, musāvādassa, pisuṇāya vācāya, pharusāya vācāya, samphappalāpassa, abhijjhāya, byāpādassa, micchādiṭṭhiyā, nekkhammena kāmacchandassa, abyāpādena byāpādassa, ālokasaññāya thinamiddhassa, avikkhepena uddhaccassa, dhammavavatthānena vicikicchāya, ñāṇena avijjāya, pāmojjena aratiyā, paṭhamena jhānena nīvaraṇānaṃ, dutiyena jhānena vitakkavicārānaṃ, tatiyena jhānena pītiyā, catutthena jhānena sukhadukkhānaṃ, ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā rūpasaññāya paṭighasaññāya nānattasaññāya, viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāya, ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññāya, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññāya, aniccānupassanāya niccasaññāya, dukkhānupassanāya sukhasaññāya, anattānupassanāya attasaññāya, nibbidānupassanāya nandiyā, virāgānupassanāya rāgassa, nirodhānupassanāya samudayassa, paṭinissaggānupassanāya ādānassa, khayānupassanāya ghanasaññāya, vayānupassanāya āyūhanassa, vipariṇāmānupassanāya dhuvasaññāya, animittānupassanāya nimittassa, appaṇihitānupassanāya paṇidhiyā, suññatānupassanāya abhinivesassa, adhipaññādhammavipassanāya sārādānābhinivesassa, yathābhūtañāṇadassanena sammohābhinivesassa, ādīnavānupassanāya ālayābhinivesassa, paṭisaṅkhānupassanāya appaṭisaṅkhāya, vivaṭṭanānupassanāya saññogābhinivesassa, sotāpattimaggena diṭṭhekaṭṭhānaṃ kilesānaṃ, sakadāgāmimaggena oḷārikānaṃ kilesānaṃ, anāgāmimaggena aṇusahagatānaṃ kilesānaṃ, arahattamaggena sabbakilesānaṃ pahānaṃ sīlaṃ, veramaṇī, cetanā, saṃvaro, avītikkamo sīlaṃ.
rows.english: (2) In the case of taking what is not given … (3) In the case of sexual misconduct … (4) In the case of false speech … (5) In the case of malicious speech … (6) In the case of harsh speech … (7) In the case of gossip … [50] (8) In the case of covetousness … (9) In the case of ill will … (10) In the case of wrong view … (11) “Through renunciation in the case of lust, (a) abandoning is virtue … (12) Through non-ill-will in the case of ill-will … (13) Through perception of light in the case of stiffness-and-torpor … (14) Through non-distraction … agitation … (15) Through definition of states (dhamma) … uncertainty … (16) Through knowledge … ignorance … (17) Through gladdening in the case of boredom … (18) “Through the first jhāna in the case of the hindrances, (a) abandoning is virtue … (19) Through the second jhāna … applied and sustained thought … (20) Through the third jhāna … happiness … (21) Through the fourth jhāna in the case of pleasure and pain, (a) abandoning is virtue … (22) Through the attainment of the base consisting of boundless space in the case of perceptions of matter, perceptions of resistance, and perceptions of variety, (a) abandoning is virtue … (23) Through the attainment of the base consisting of boundless consciousness in the case of the perception of the base consisting of boundless space … (24) Through the attainment of the base consisting of nothingness in the case of the perception of the base consisting of boundless consciousness … (25) Through the attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perception in the case of the perception of the base consisting of nothingness … (26) “Through the contemplation of impermanence in the case of the perception of permanence, (a) abandoning is virtue … (27) Through the contemplation of pain in the case of the perception of pleasure … (28) Through the contemplation of not-self in the case of the perception of self … (29) Through the contemplation of dispassion in the case of the perception of delighting … (30) Through the contemplation of fading away in the case of greed … (31) Through the contemplation of cessation in the case of originating … (32) Through the contemplation of relinquishment in the case of grasping … (33) “Through the contemplation of destruction in the case of the perception of compactness, (a) abandoning is virtue … (34) Through the contemplation of fall [of formations] in the case of accumulating [kamma] … (35) Through the contemplation of change in the case of the perception of lastingness … (36) Through the contemplation of the signless in the case of a sign … (37) Through the contemplation of the desireless in the case of desire … (38) Through the contemplation of voidness in the case of misinterpreting (insistence) … (39) Through insight into states that is higher understanding in the case of misinterpreting (insistence) due to grasping … (40) Through correct knowledge and vision in the case of misinterpreting (insistence) due to confusion … (41) Through the contemplation of danger in the case of misinterpreting (insistence) due to reliance [on formations] … (42) Through reflection in the case of non-reflection … (43) Through the contemplation of turning away in the case of misinterpreting (insistence) due to bondage …
rows.chinese_translation: “五种戒：舍弃杀生是戒，离弃是戒，意志是戒，防护是戒，不违犯是戒。

rows.pali: Evarūpāni sīlāni cittassa avippaṭisārāya saṃvattanti, pāmojjāya saṃvattanti, pītiyā saṃvattanti, passaddhiyā saṃvattanti, somanassāya saṃvattanti, āsevanāya saṃvattanti, bhāvanāya saṃvattanti, bahulīkammāya saṃvattanti, alaṅkārāya saṃvattanti, parikkhārāya saṃvattanti, parivārāya saṃvattanti, pāripūriyā saṃvattanti, ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantī"ti (paṭi. ma. 1.41).
rows.english: (44) “Through the path of stream-entry in the case of defilements coefficient with [false] view, (a) abandoning is virtue … (45) Through the path of once-return in the case of gross defilements … (46) Through the path of non-return in the case of residual defilements … (47) Through the path of Arahantship in the case of all defilements, (a) abandoning is virtue, (b) abstention is virtue, (c) volition is virtue, (d) restraint is virtue, (e) non-transgression is virtue. “Such virtues lead to non-remorse in the mind, to gladdening, to happiness, to tranquillity, to joy, to repetition, to development, to cultivation, to embellishment, to the requisite [for concentration], to the equipment [of concentration], to fulfilment, to complete dispassion, to fading away, to cessation, to peace, to direct-knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna.”38 (Paṭis I 46–47)
rows.note: 38. This list describes, in terms of abandoning, etc., the stages in the normal progress from ignorance to Arahantship, and it falls into th...
rows.chinese_translation: 对于不取、不邪淫、妄语、两舌、恶口、绮语、贪欲、瞋恚、邪见，以及以出离对治欲贪、以不瞋对治瞋恚、以光明想对治昏沉睡眠、以不散乱对治掉举、以分别法对治疑惑、以智慧对治无明、以喜悦对治不乐、以初禅对治五盖、以第二禅对治寻伺、以第三禅对治喜、以第四禅对治苦乐、以空无边处定对治色想和有对想等；以识无边处定对治空无边处想，以无所有处定对治识无边处想，以非想非非想处定对治无所有处想；以观无常对治常想，以观苦对治乐想，以观无我对治我想，以观厌离对治喜爱，以观离贪对治贪，以观灭对治集，以观舍离对治取，以观坏灭对治坚实想，以观消散对治积聚，以观变易对治恒常想，以观无相对治相，以观无愿对治愿，以观空对治执著，以增上慧法观对治执取实质，以如实知见对治迷乱执著，以观过患对治住著，以审察对治不审察，以转向对治结缚执著；以须陀洹道舍弃见所断烦恼，以斯陀含道舍弃粗重烦恼，以阿那含道舍弃细微烦恼，以阿罗汉道舍弃一切烦恼——这一切都是戒：离、意志、防护和不违犯也都是戒。”
rows.translation_note: 长引文以“对治关系”系统列举五戒及修行阶段的戒义。

rows.pali: Ettha ca pahānanti koci dhammo nāma natthi aññatra vuttappakārānaṃ pāṇātipātādīnaṃ anuppādamattato.
rows.english: 141.And here there is no state called abandoning other than the mere non-arising of the killing of living things, etc., as stated.
rows.chinese_translation: 这类戒使心不后悔，导向喜悦、欢喜、轻安、悦意、修习、增长、庄严、资助、围绕、圆满，并导向彻底厌离、离贪、灭、寂静、神通、正觉和涅槃。”

rows.pali: Yasmā pana taṃ taṃ pahānaṃ tassa tassa kusaladhammassa patiṭṭhānaṭṭhena upadhāraṇaṃ hoti, vikampābhāvakaraṇena ca samādānaṃ.
rows.english: But the abandoning of a given [unprofitable state] upholds a given profitable state in the sense of providing a foundation for it, and concentrates it by preventing wavering,
rows.chinese_translation: 这里所谓“舍弃”并不是另有一种法，只是前面所说杀生等不生起。

rows.pali: Tasmā pubbe vutteneva upadhāraṇasamādhānasaṅkhātena sīlanaṭṭhena sīlanti vuttaṃ.
rows.english: so it is called “virtue” (sīla) in the sense of composing (sīlana), reckoned as upholding and concentrating as stated earlier (§19).
rows.chinese_translation: 但是，因为这种种舍弃以安立相应善法为意义而成为支撑，并以不动摇为意义而成为受持，

rows.pali: Itare cattāro dhammā tato tato veramaṇivasena, tassa tassa saṃvaravasena, tadubhayasampayuttacetanāvasena, taṃ taṃ avītikkamantassa avītikkamanavasena ca cetaso pavattisabbhāvaṃ sandhāya vuttā.
rows.english: The other four things mentioned refer to the presence39 of occurrence of will as abstention from such and such, as restraint of such and such, as the volition associated with both of these, and as non-transgression in one who does not transgress such and such.
rows.note: 39. Sabbhāva—“presence” ( = sat + bhāva): not in PED. Not to be confused with sabhāva— “individual essence” ( = sa (Skr. sva) + bhāva, or sa...
rows.chinese_translation: 所以沿用前文“支撑、整合”的戒义，称为戒。

rows.pali: Sīlaṭṭho pana tesaṃ pubbe pakāsitoyevāti.
rows.english: But their meaning of virtue has been explained already.
rows.chinese_translation: 其余四种，是分别就离弃、相应防护、与二者相应的意志，以及不越犯者心的实际活动而言。

rows.pali: Evaṃ pahānasīlādivasena pañcavidhaṃ.
rows.english: So it is of five kinds as “virtue consisting in abandoning” and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 至于戒的意义，在前面已经解释清楚。

rows.pali: Ettāvatā ca kiṃ sīlaṃ?
rows.english: 142. At this point “What is virtue?
rows.chinese_translation: 这样，戒依舍弃等分为五种。

rows.pali: Kenaṭṭhena sīlaṃ?
rows.english: In what sense is it virtue?
rows.chinese_translation: 至此，什么是戒？

rows.pali: Kānassa lakkhaṇarasapaccupaṭṭhānapadaṭṭhānāni?
rows.english: What are its characteristic, function, manifestation, and proximate cause?
rows.chinese_translation: 戒在什么意义上称为戒？

rows.pali: Kimānisaṃsaṃ sīlaṃ?
rows.english: What are the benefits of virtue?
rows.chinese_translation: 它的特征、作用、现起和近因是什么？
rows.translation_note: 这里的五问回顾本品前文的主要分析框架。

rows.pali: Katividhaṃ cetaṃ sīlanti?
rows.english: How many kinds of virtue are there?”
rows.chinese_translation: 戒有什么功德？

rows.pali: Imesaṃ pañhānaṃ vissajjanaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
rows.english: the answers to the questions are complete.
rows.chinese_translation: 戒有多少种？

rows.pali: 21.Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ "ko cassa saṃkileso, kiṃ vodāna"nti.
rows.english: 143. However, it was also asked (vi) WHAT IS THE DEFILING OF IT? and WHAT IS THE CLEANSING OF IT?
rows.chinese_translation: 这些问题的回答到此结束。

rows.pali: Tatra vadāma – khaṇḍādibhāvo sīlassa saṃkileso, akhaṇḍādibhāvo vodānaṃ.
rows.english: We answer that virtue’s tornness, etc., is its defiling, and that its untornness, etc., is its cleansing.
rows.chinese_translation: 至于前面所说“戒的杂染是什么，清净是什么”，

rows.pali: So pana khaṇḍādibhāvo lābhayasādihetukena bhedena ca sattavidhamethunasaṃyogena ca saṅgahito.
rows.english: Now, that tornness, etc., are comprised under the breach that has gain, fame, etc., as its cause, and under the seven bonds of sexuality.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里回答：戒的杂染是破损等状态，清净是无破损等状态。
rows.translation_note: 破损与破洞开始引出戒的杂染分类。

rows.pali: Tathā hi yassa sattasu āpattikkhandhesu ādimhi vā ante vā sikkhāpadaṃ bhinnaṃ hoti, tassa sīlaṃ pariyante chinnasāṭako viya khaṇḍaṃ nāma hoti.
rows.english: When a man has broken the training course at the beginning or at the end in any instance of the seven classes of offences,40 his virtue is called torn, like a cloth that is cut at the edge.
rows.chinese_translation: 破损等状态包括由利得、名誉等原因造成的破坏，以及七种性关系。

rows.pali: Yassa pana vemajjhe bhinnaṃ, tassa majjhe chiddasāṭako viya chiddaṃ nāma hoti.
rows.english: But when he has broken it in the middle, it is called rent, like a cloth that is rent in the middle.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为，如果在七类罪聚的开头或结尾破坏学处，他的戒就像衣服边缘断裂一样，称为“破损”。

rows.pali: Yassa paṭipāṭiyā dve tīṇi bhinnāni, tassa piṭṭhiyā vā kucchiyā vā uṭṭhitena visabhāgavaṇṇena kāḷarattādīnaṃ aññatarasarīravaṇṇā gāvī viya sabalaṃ nāma hoti.
rows.english: When he has broken it twice or thrice in succession, it is called blotched, like a cow whose body is some such colour as black or red with a discrepant colour appearing on the back or the belly.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果连续两三条学处被破坏，就像牛背或牛腹上长出一块异色毛，称为斑驳。

rows.pali: Yassa antarantarā bhinnāni, tassa antarantarā visabhāgavaṇṇabinduvicitrā gāvī viya kammāsaṃ nāma hoti.
rows.english: When he has broken it [all over] at intervals, it is called mottled, like a cow speckled [all over] with discrepant- coloured spots at intervals.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果间隔着被破坏，就像牛身上间隔分布异色斑点，称为杂色。

rows.pali: Evaṃ tāva lābhādihetukena bhedena khaṇḍādibhāvo hoti.
rows.english: This in the first place, is how there comes to be tornness with the breach that has gain, etc., as its cause.
rows.chinese_translation: 以上是由利得等原因造成破坏时，戒成为破损等状态。

rows.pali: Evaṃ sattavidhamethunasaṃyogavasena.
rows.english: 144.And likewise with the seven bonds of sexuality;
rows.chinese_translation: 以上也是由七种性关系造成破坏时的情况。

rows.pali: Vuttañhi bhagavatā –
rows.english: for this is said by the Blessed One:
rows.chinese_translation: 世尊说：

rows.pali: "Idha, brāhmaṇa, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā sammā brahmacārī paṭijānamāno na heva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayaṃdvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati, apica kho mātugāmassa ucchādanaṃ parimaddanaṃ nhāpanaṃ sambāhanaṃ sādiyati, so tadassādeti, taṃ nikāmeti, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati, idampi kho, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyassa khaṇḍampi chiddampi sabalampi kammāsampi.
rows.english: “Here, brahman, some ascetic or brahman claims to lead the life of purity rightly; for he does not enter into actual sexual intercourse with women. Yet he agrees to massage, manipulation, bathing and rubbing down by women. He enjoys it, desires it and takes satisfaction in it. This is what is torn, rent, blotched and mottled in one who leads the life of purity.
rows.chinese_translation: “婆罗门，在这里，有些沙门或婆罗门自称完全修行梵行；他虽然没有与女人发生两两交合，却接受女人为他涂抹、按摩、洗浴和搓身；他对此感到满足、喜爱，并从中得到快乐。这也是梵行的破损、破洞、斑驳和杂色。
rows.translation_note: 七种性关系的列举采用递进省略，正文保留从身体接触到愿生天界的范围。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇa, aparisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati saṃyutto methunena saṃyogena, na parimuccati jātiyā.
rows.english: This man is said to lead a life of purity that is unclean. As one who is bound by the bond of sexuality, he will not be released from birth,
rows.chinese_translation: “婆罗门，这称为他修行不清净的梵行，被性关系束缚，不能从生、老、死和苦中解脱。

rows.pali: Jarāya maraṇena - pe - na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
rows.english: ageing and death … he will not be released from suffering, I say.
rows.chinese_translation: 再次，婆罗门，有人虽然没有与女人交合，也不接受为女人涂抹等，却与女人嬉笑、游戏、调笑；他对此感到满足……我说，他也不能从苦中解脱。

rows.pali: "Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā - pe - paṭijānamāno na heva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayaṃ dvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati.
rows.english: 145. “Furthermore, brahman, … while he does not agree to [these things],
rows.chinese_translation: 再次，婆罗门，有人既不与女人交合，也不接受涂抹等，也不与女人嬉笑游戏，然而用眼凝视女人的眼睛；他对此感到满足……我说，他也不能从苦中解脱。

rows.pali: Napi mātugāmassa ucchādanaṃ - pe - sādiyati.
rows.chinese_translation: 再次，婆罗门，有人不做前面那些事，却隔墙、隔壁听女人笑、说、唱或哭的声音；他对此感到满足……我说，他也不能从苦中解脱。

rows.pali: Apica kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṃkīḷati saṃkelāyati, so tadassādeti - pe - na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
rows.english: yet he jokes, plays and amuses himself with women …
rows.chinese_translation: 再次，婆罗门，有人不做前面那些事，却回忆过去与女人一起笑、谈、游戏的事；他对此感到满足……我说，他也不能从苦中解脱。

rows.pali: "Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā - pe - na heva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayaṃ dvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati.
rows.english: 146. “Furthermore, brahman, … while he does not agree to [these things],
rows.chinese_translation: 再次，婆罗门，有人既不做前面那些事，也不回忆过去的嬉戏，却看见某位居士或居士子享受并具足五种欲乐；他对此感到满足……我说，他也不能从苦中解脱。

rows.pali: Napi mātugāmassa ucchādanaṃ - pe - sādiyati.
rows.chinese_translation: 再次，婆罗门，有人不做前面那些事，也不看居士或居士子享受五欲，却发愿修行梵行，心想‘凭此戒、行、苦行或梵行，我将成为某类天神’。

rows.pali: Napi mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṃkīḷati saṃkelāyati.
rows.chinese_translation: 他对此感到满足、喜爱，并从中得到快乐。这也是梵行的破损、破洞、斑驳和杂色。”

rows.pali: Apica kho mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati, so tadassādeti - pe - na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
rows.english: yet he gazes and stares at women eye to eye …
rows.chinese_translation: 应知，戒的破损等状态包括由利得等原因造成的破坏，也包括七种性关系。

rows.pali: "Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā - pe - na heva kho mātugāmena… napi mātugāmassa… napi mātugāmena… napi mātugāmassa - pe - pekkhati.
rows.english: 147. “Furthermore, brahman, … while he does not agree to [these things],
rows.chinese_translation: 清净、无破损等状态，则由以下因素构成：完全不破坏学处；破戒后作适当补救；没有七种性关系；不生起忿怒、怨结、轻蔑、敌意、嫉妒、悭吝、欺骗、虚伪、固执、争胜、慢、过慢、放逸等恶法；并生起少欲、知足、简朴等功德。
rows.translation_note: 清净状态的条件同时包括补救、离欲、无恶法和善法增长。

rows.pali: Apica kho mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti tirokuṭṭā vā tiropākārā vā hasantiyā vā bhaṇantiyā vā gāyantiyā vā rodantiyā vā, so tadassādeti - pe - dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
rows.english: yet he listens to the sound of women through a wall or through a fence as they laugh or talk or sing or weep …
rows.chinese_translation: 那些即使为利得等目的也不破坏的戒，或因放逸而破坏后已经补救的戒，或未被性关系及忿怒、怨结等恶法损害的戒，都称为完全无破损、无破洞、无斑驳、无杂色。

rows.pali: "Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā - pe - na heva kho mātugāmena… napi mātugāmassa… napi mātugāmena… napi mātugāmassa - pe - rodantiyā vā.
rows.english: 148. “Furthermore, brahman, … while he does not agree to [these things], yet he
rows.chinese_translation: 这些戒还因使人成为自由人而称为自由戒，因智者赞叹而称为智者所赞，因不被贪爱和邪见执取而称为不取著，并能导向近行定或安止定，所以称为导向定。

rows.pali: Apica kho yānissa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni, tāni anussarati, so tadassādeti - pe - dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
rows.english: recalls laughs and talks and games that he formerly had with women …
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，应知它们的无破损等状态就是清净。

rows.pali: "Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā - pe - na heva kho mātugāmena - pe - napi mātugāmassa - pe - napi yānissa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni, tāni anussarati.
rows.english: 149. “Furthermore, brahman, … while he does not agree to [these things],
rows.chinese_translation: 这种清净通过两种方式成就：看见破戒的过患，以及看见持戒成就的功德。

rows.pali: Apica kho passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgībhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ, so tadassādeti - pe - dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
rows.english: yet he sees a householder or a householder’s son possessed of, endowed with, and indulging in, the five cords of sense desire …
rows.chinese_translation: 其中，应依经中“比丘们，破戒、戒行败坏有五种过患”等教说，观察戒行败坏的过患。

rows.pali: "Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā - pe - na heva kho mātugāmena - pe - napi passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā - pe - paricārayamānaṃ.
rows.english: 150. “Furthermore, brahman, while he does not agree to [these things],
rows.chinese_translation: 此外，不持戒的人因恶戒而不受天人喜爱，梵行同伴也不应教导他；受到责备时痛苦，听到赞叹持戒者时后悔；因恶戒而像粗布衣一样丑陋。

rows.pali: Apica kho aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati 'imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā'ti.
rows.english: yet he leads the life of purity aspiring to some order of deities, [thinking] ‘Through this rite (virtue) or this ritual (vow) or this asceticism I shall become a [great] deity or some [lesser] deity.’
rows.chinese_translation: 那些跟随他的行为而行的人，会长久带来恶趣之苦，所以与苦相接触。

rows.pali: So tadassādeti, taṃ nikāmeti, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati.
rows.english: He enjoys it, desires it, and takes satisfaction in it.
rows.chinese_translation: 接受他们布施的人，因为不能使布施产生广大果报，所以所得价值很小。

rows.pali: Idampi kho, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyassa khaṇḍampi chiddampi sabalampi kammāsampī"ti (a. ni. 7.50).
rows.english: This, brahman, is what is torn, rent, blotched and mottled in one who leads the life of purity. This man … will not be released from suffering, I say” (A IV 54–56).
rows.chinese_translation: 像积存多年的粪坑一样难以清净。

rows.pali: Evaṃ lābhādihetukena bhedena ca sattavidhamethunasaṃyogena ca khaṇḍādibhāvo saṅgahitoti veditabbo.
rows.english: This is how tornness, etc., should be understood as included under the breach that has gain, etc., as its cause and under the seven bonds of sexuality.
rows.chinese_translation: 像两头燃烧的木柴一样，两边都被排斥。

rows.pali: Akhaṇḍādibhāvo pana sabbaso sikkhāpadānaṃ abhedena, bhinnānañca sappaṭikammānaṃ paṭikammakaraṇena, sattavidhamethunasaṃyogābhāvena ca, aparāya ca "kodho upanāho makkho paḷāso issā macchariyaṃ māyā sātheyyaṃ thambho sārambho māno atimāno mado pamādo"tiādīnaṃ pāpadhammānaṃ anuppattiyā, appicchatāsantuṭṭhitāsallekhatādīnañca guṇānaṃ uppattiyā saṅgahito.
rows.english: 151.Untornness, however, is accomplished by the complete non-breaking of the training precepts, by making amends for those broken for which amends should be made, by the absence of the seven bonds of sexuality, and, as well, by the non- arising of such evil things as anger, enmity, contempt, domineering, envy, avarice, deceit, fraud, obduracy, presumption, pride (conceit), haughtiness, conceit (vanity), and negligence (MN 7), and by the arising of such qualities as fewness of wishes, contentment, and effacement (MN 24).
rows.chinese_translation: 虽然自称比丘，却像跟随牛群的驴一样，仍然不是比丘。

rows.pali: Yāni hi sīlāni lābhādīnampi atthāya abhinnāni, pamādadosena vā bhinnānipi paṭikammakatāni, methunasaṃyogehi vā kodhupanāhādīhi vā pāpadhammehi anupahatāni, tāni sabbaso akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsānīti vuccanti.
rows.english: 152. Virtues not broken for the purpose of gain, etc., and rectified by making amends after being broken by the faults of negligence, etc., and not damaged by the bonds of sexuality and by such evil things as anger and enmity, are called entirely untorn, unrent, unblotched, and unmottled.
rows.chinese_translation: 像一切仇敌一样，始终处于恐惧中。

rows.pali: Tāniyeva bhujissabhāvakaraṇato ca bhujissāni, viññūhi pasatthattā viññupasatthāni, taṇhādiṭṭhīhi aparāmaṭṭhattā aparāmaṭṭhāni, upacārasamādhiṃ vā appanāsamādhiṃ vā saṃvattayantīti samādhisaṃvattanikāni ca honti.
rows.english: And those same virtues are liberating since they bring about the state of a freeman, and praised by the wise since it is by the wise that they are praised, and unadhered-to since they are not adhered to by means of craving and views, and conducive to concentration since they conduce to access concentration or to absorption concentration.
rows.chinese_translation: 像死尸一样，不适合与人共住。
rows.translation_note: “两头燃烧”表示既不为世俗接受，也不为教团接受。

rows.pali: Tasmā nesaṃ esa 'akhaṇḍādibhāvo vodāna'nti veditabbo.
rows.english: That is why their untornness, etc., should be understood as “cleansing” (see also VII.101f.).
rows.chinese_translation: 即使具足听闻等功德，也像婆罗门眼中的墓火一样，不值得梵行同伴礼敬。

rows.pali: Taṃ panetaṃ vodānaṃ dvīhākārehi sampajjati sīlavipattiyā ca ādīnavadassanena, sīlasampattiyā ca ānisaṃsadassanena.
rows.english: 153.This cleansing comes about in two ways: through seeing the danger of failure in virtue, and through seeing the benefit of perfected virtue.
rows.chinese_translation: 不能获得更高成就，像盲人不能看见色。

rows.pali: Tattha "pañcime, bhikkhave, ādīnavā dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā"ti (dī. ni. 2.149; a. ni. 5.213) evamādisuttanayena sīlavipattiyā ādīnavo daṭṭhabbo.
rows.english: Herein, the danger of failure in virtue can be seen in accordance with such suttas as that beginning, “Bhikkhus, there are these five dangers for the unvirtuous in the failure of virtue” (A III 252).
rows.chinese_translation: 对正法绝望，像旃陀罗少年不能继承王位。

rows.pali: Apica dussīlo puggalo dussīlyahetu amanāpo hoti devamanussānaṃ, ananusāsanīyo sabrahmacārīnaṃ, dukkhito dussīlyagarahāsu, vippaṭisārī sīlavataṃ pasaṃsāsu, tāya ca pana dussīlyatāya sāṇasāṭako viya dubbaṇṇo hoti.
rows.english: 154. Furthermore, on account of his unvirtuousness an unvirtuous person is displeasing to deities and human beings, is uninstructable by his fellows in the life of purity, suffers when unvirtuousness is censured, and is remorseful when the virtuous are praised. Owing to that unvirtuousness he is as ugly as hemp cloth.
rows.chinese_translation: 虽然自以为快乐，却因《火聚经》所说的苦而实际上痛苦。

rows.pali: Ye kho panassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti, tesaṃ dīgharattaṃ apāyadukkhāvahanato dukkhasamphasso.
rows.english: Contact with him is painful because those who fall in with his views are brought to long-lasting suffering in the states of loss.
rows.chinese_translation: 不持戒者的心贪著五欲、礼敬、恭敬等快乐；世尊说，他们只要回忆这些因缘，便会生起心中灼热、吐出热血般的极苦，果报在一切方面都可现前：

rows.pali: Yesaṃ deyyadhammaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, tesaṃ namahapphalakaraṇato appaggho.
rows.english: He is worthless because he causes no great fruit [to accrue] to those who give him gifts.
rows.chinese_translation: “比丘们，你们看见那团巨大、燃烧、炽盛、放光的火吗？”

rows.pali: Anekavassagaṇikagūthakūpo viya dubbisodhano.
rows.english: He is as hard to purify as a cesspit many years old.
rows.chinese_translation: “是的，尊者。”

rows.pali: Chavālātamiva ubhato paribāhiro.
rows.english: He is like a log from a pyre (see It 99); for he is outside both [recluseship and the lay state].
rows.chinese_translation: “比丘们，你们认为怎样？是拥抱、坐在或躺在那团燃烧的巨大火聚上好，还是拥抱、坐在或躺在手脚柔软的刹帝利女子、婆罗门女子或居士女子身上好？”
rows.translation_note: 此处说明不持戒的现世和后世果报，譬喻密集。

rows.pali: Bhikkhubhāvaṃ paṭijānantopi abhikkhuyeva gogaṇaṃ anubandhagadrabho viya.
rows.english: Though claiming the bhikkhu state he is no bhikkhu, so he is like a donkey following a herd of cattle.
rows.chinese_translation: “尊者，拥抱、坐在或躺在那些女子身上更好。”

rows.pali: Satatubbiggo sabbaverikapuriso viya.
rows.english: He is always nervous, like a man who is everyone’s enemy.
rows.chinese_translation: “拥抱、坐在或躺在那团燃烧的巨大火聚上，是痛苦的。”

rows.pali: Asaṃvāsāraho matakaḷevaraṃ viya.
rows.english: He is as unfit to live with as a dead carcase.
rows.chinese_translation: 应知这段教说是用火聚譬喻说明恶戒的苦果。

rows.pali: Sutādiguṇayuttopi sabrahmacārīnaṃ apūjāraho susānaggi viya brāhmaṇānaṃ.
rows.english: Though he may have the qualities of learning, etc., he is as unfit for the homage of his fellows in the life of purity as a charnel-ground fire is for that of brahmans.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，破戒的过患应依这些譬喻理解。

rows.pali: Abhabbo visesādhigame andho viya rūpadassane.
rows.english: He is as incapable of reaching the distinction of attainment as a blind man is of seeing a visible object.
rows.chinese_translation: 持戒者应避免造成破损、破洞、斑驳和杂色的行为。

rows.pali: Nirāso saddhamme caṇḍālakumārako viya rajje.
rows.english: He is as careless of the Good Law as a guttersnipe is of a kingdom.
rows.chinese_translation: 这些教说进一步说明戒行与梵行清净的关系。

rows.pali: Sukhitosmīti maññamānopi dukkhitova aggikkhandhapariyāye vuttadukkhabhāgitāya.
rows.english: Though he fancies he is happy, yet he suffers because he reaps suffering as told in the Discourse on the Mass of Fire (A IV 128–34).
rows.chinese_translation: 不清净的戒会带来现世和后世的痛苦。

rows.pali: Dussīlānañhi pañcakāmaguṇaparibhogavandanamānanādisukhassādagadhitacittānaṃ tappaccayaṃ anussaraṇamattenāpi hadayasantāpaṃ janayitvā uṇhalohituggārappavattanasamatthaṃ atikaṭukaṃ dukkhaṃ dassento sabbākārena paccakkhakammavipāko bhagavā āha –
rows.english: 155.Now, the Blessed One has shown that when the unvirtuous have their minds captured by pleasure and satisfaction in the indulgence of the five cords of sense desires, in [receiving] salutation, in being honoured, etc., the result of that kamma, directly visible in all ways, is very violent pain, with that [kamma] as its condition, capable of producing a gush of hot blood by causing agony of heart with the mere recollection of it.
rows.chinese_translation: 清净的戒则能支持修行者走向解脱。
rows.translation_note: 火聚譬喻以极端对比说明不持戒者的欲乐果报。

rows.pali: "Passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, amuṃ mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūta'nti?
rows.english: Here is the text: “Bhikkhus, do you see that great mass of fire burning, blazing and glowing?
rows.chinese_translation: 以上是对戒杂染及其过患的说明。

rows.pali: Evaṃ, bhanteti.
rows.english: — Yes, venerable sir.
rows.chinese_translation: 这些分类应依具体犯戒情形和性关系判断。

rows.pali: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ amuṃ mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ āliṅgetvā upanisīdeyya vā upanipajjeyya vā, yaṃ khattiyakaññaṃ vā brāhmaṇakaññaṃ vā gahapatikaññaṃ vā mudutalunahatthapādaṃ āliṅgetvā upanisīdeyya vā upanipajjeyya vāti.
rows.english: —What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one [gone forth] should sit down or lie down embracing that mass of fire burning, blazing and glowing, or that he should sit down or lie down embracing a warrior-noble maiden or a brahman maiden or a maiden of householder family, with soft, delicate hands and feet?
rows.chinese_translation: 对于省略的经文，应依前文递进结构补足理解。

rows.pali: Etadeva, bhante, varaṃ yaṃ khattiyakaññaṃ vā - pe - upanipajjeyya vā.
rows.english: —It would be better, venerable sir, that he should sit down or lie down embracing a warrior-noble maiden …
rows.chinese_translation: 本段以譬喻强调守护戒行的重要性。

rows.pali: Dukkhaṃ hetaṃ, bhante, yaṃ amuṃ mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ - pe - upanipajjeyya vāti.
rows.english: It would be painful, venerable sir, if he sat down or lay down embracing that great mass of fire burning, blazing and glowing.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此应当谨慎维持戒的清净。

rows.pali: Ārocayāmi vo, bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo, bhikkhave, yathā etadeva tassa varaṃ dussīlassa pāpadhammassa asucisaṅkassarasamācārassa paṭicchannakammantassa assamaṇassa samaṇapaṭiññassa abrahmacārissa brahmacāripaṭiññassa antopūtikassa avassutassa kasambujātassa yaṃ amuṃ mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ - pe - upanipajjeyya vā.
rows.english: 156. “I say to you, bhikkhus, I declare to you, bhikkhus, that it would be better for one [gone forth] who is unvirtuous, who is evil-natured, of unclean and suspect habits, secretive of his acts, who is not an ascetic and claims to be one, who does not lead the life of purity and claims to do so, who is rotten within, lecherous, and full of corruption, to sit down or lie down embracing that great mass of fire burning, blazing and glowing.
rows.chinese_translation: “比丘们，我告诉你们、使你们明白：对于那个恶戒、恶法、行为不净而可疑、隐藏行为、不是沙门却自称沙门、不是梵行者却自称梵行者、内里腐败、内里湿污、像粪土一样的人，究竟哪一个更好：拥抱、坐在或躺在那团巨大火聚上，还是拥抱、坐在或躺在刹帝利、婆罗门或居士女子身上？”
rows.translation_note: 长引文的主旨是：接受世俗供养若以破戒为代价，苦果远超过身体痛苦。

rows.pali: Taṃ kissa hetu?
rows.english: Why is that?
rows.chinese_translation: 为什么？

rows.pali: Tatonidānaṃ hi so, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ, na tveva tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyā"ti (a. ni. 7.72).
rows.english: By his doing so, bhikkhus, he might come to death or deadly suffering, yet he would not on that account, on the breakup of the body, after death, reappear in states of loss, in an unhappy destiny, in perdition, in hell. But if one who is unvirtuous, evil-natured … and full of corruption, should sit down or lie down embracing a warrior-noble maiden … that would be long for his harm and suffering: on the break-up of the body, after death, he would reappear in states of loss, in an unhappy destiny, in perdition, in hell” (A IV 128–29).
rows.chinese_translation: 因为他可能因此死亡，或遭受近于死亡的痛苦，却不会因为这个缘故，身坏命终后投生恶趣、堕处、地狱。”

rows.pali: Evaṃ aggikkhandhupamāya itthipaṭibaddhapañcakāmaguṇaparibhogapaccayaṃ dukkhaṃ dassetvā eteneva upāyena –
rows.english: 157.Having thus shown by means of the analogy of the mass of fire the suffering that is bound up with women and has as its condition the indulgence of the five cords of sense desires [by the unvirtuous],
rows.chinese_translation: 这样以火聚譬喻显示贪著女人和五欲的苦后，又以同样的方法说：

rows.pali: "Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso daḷhāya vāḷarajjuyā ubho jaṅghā veṭhetvā ghaṃseyya, sā chaviṃ chindeyya, chaviṃ chetvā cammaṃ chindeyya, cammaṃ chetvā maṃsaṃ chindeyya, maṃsaṃ chetvā nhāruṃ chindeyya, nhāruṃ chetvā aṭṭhiṃ chindeyya, aṭṭhiṃ chetvā aṭṭhimiñjaṃ āhacca tiṭṭheyya, yaṃ vā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā abhivādanaṃ sādiyeyyā"ti ca.
rows.english: “What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one should have a strong horse- hair rope twisted round both legs by a strong man and tightened so that it cut through the outer skin, and having cut through the outer skin it cut through the inner skin, and having cut through the inner skin it cut through the flesh, and having cut through the flesh it cut through the sinews, and having cut through the sinews it cut through the bones, and having cut through the bones it remained crushing the bone marrow—or that he should consent to the homage of great warrior-nobles, great brahmans, great householders? ” (A IV 129).
rows.chinese_translation: “比丘们，你们认为怎样？强壮的人用结实的毛绳缠绕双腿并摩擦，使皮、肉、筋、骨乃至骨髓逐层破裂，哪一个更好：接受刹帝利、婆罗门或居士大户的礼敬，还是这样？”

rows.pali: "Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso tiṇhāya sattiyā teladhotāya paccorasmiṃ pahareyya, yaṃ vā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā añjalikammaṃ sādiyeyyā"ti ca.
rows.english: And: “What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one should have a strong man wound one’s breast with a sharp spear tempered in oil—or that he should consent to the reverential salutation of great warrior-nobles, great brahmans, great householders? ” (A IV 130).
rows.chinese_translation: “比丘们，你们认为怎样？强壮的人用锋利、油磨的矛刺穿胸部，哪一个更好：接受刹帝利、婆罗门或居士大户合掌礼，还是这样？”

rows.pali: "Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso tattena ayopaṭṭena ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena kāyaṃ sampaliveṭheyya, yaṃ vā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjeyyā"ti ca.
rows.english: And: “What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one’s body should be wrapped by a strong man in a red-hot iron sheet burning, blazing and glowing— or that he should use robes given out of faith by great warrior-nobles, great brahmans, great householders? ” (A IV 130–31).
rows.chinese_translation: “比丘们，你们认为怎样？强壮的人用烧红、炽燃、发光的铁片包裹身体，哪一个更好：受用刹帝利、婆罗门或居士大户信心供养的袈裟，还是这样？”

rows.pali: "Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso tattena ayosaṅkunā ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena mukhaṃ vivaritvā tattaṃ lohaguḷaṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ mukhe pakkhipeyya, taṃ tassa oṭṭhampi ḍaheyya, mukhampi, jivhampi, kaṇṭhampi, udarampi ḍaheyya, antampi antaguṇampi ādāya adhobhāgaṃ nikkhameyya, yaṃ vā khattiya… brāhmaṇa… gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjeyyā"ti ca.
rows.english: And: “What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one’s mouth should be prised open by a strong man with red-hot iron tongs burning, blazing and glowing, and that into his mouth should be put a red-hot iron ball burning, blazing and glowing, which burns his lips and burns his mouth and tongue and throat and belly and passes out below carrying with it his bowels and entrails—or that he should use alms food given out of faith by great warrior-nobles …? ” (A IV 131–32).
rows.chinese_translation: “比丘们，你们认为怎样？强壮的人掰开嘴，把烧红发光的铁球投入其中，烧焦嘴唇、口腔、舌、喉、胃，并带着肠和肠系膜从下方排出；哪一个更好：受用大户以信心供养的食物，还是这样？”

rows.pali: "Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso sīse vā gahetvā khandhe vā gahetvā tattaṃ ayomañcaṃ vā ayopīṭhaṃ vā ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ abhinisīdāpeyya vā abhinipajjāpeyya vā, yaṃ vā khattiya… brāhmaṇa… gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ mañcapīṭhaṃ paribhuñjeyyā"ti ca.
rows.english: And: “What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one should have a strong man seize him by the head or seize him by the shoulders and seat him or lay him on a red-hot iron bed or iron chair, burning, blazing and glowing—or that he should use a bed or chair given out of faith by great warrior-nobles …? ” (A IV 132–33).
rows.chinese_translation: “比丘们，你们认为怎样？强壮的人抓住头或肩，让人坐或躺在烧红发光的铁床或铁凳上，哪一个更好：受用大户以信心供养的床座，还是这样？”

rows.pali: "Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso uddhaṃpādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya ayokumbhiyā pakkhipeyya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya, so tattha pheṇuddehakaṃ paccamāno sakimpi uddhaṃ gaccheyya, sakimpi adho gaccheyya, sakimpi tiriyaṃ gaccheyya, yaṃ vā khattiya… brāhmaṇa… gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ vihāraṃ paribhuñjeyyā"ti cāti (a. ni. 7.72).
rows.english: And: “What do you think, bhikkhus, which is better, that one should have a strong man take him feet up and head down and plunge him into a red-hot metal cauldron burning, blazing and glowing, to be boiled there in a swirl of froth, and as he boils in the swirl of froth to be swept now up, now down, and now across—or that he should use a dwelling given out of faith by great warrior-nobles …? ” (A IV 133–34).
rows.chinese_translation: “比丘们，你们认为怎样？强壮的人把人倒置，脚朝上、头朝下，投入烧红发光的铁锅；在那里煮得泡沫翻涌，时而上、时而下、时而横向翻滚；哪一个更好：受用大户以信心供养的住处，还是这样？”

rows.pali: Imāhi vāḷarajjutiṇhasattiayopaṭṭaayoguḷaayomañcaayopīṭhaayokumbhīupamāhi abhivādanaañjalikammacīvarapiṇḍapātamañcapīṭhavihāraparibhogapaccayaṃ dukkhaṃ dassesi.
rows.english: to the same intent he showed, by the following similes of the horse-hair rope, the sharp spear, the iron sheet, the iron ball, the iron bed, the iron chair, and the iron cauldron, the pain that has as its condition [acceptance of] homage and reverential salutation, and the use of robes, alms food, bed and chair, and dwelling [by unvirtuous bhikkhus] (above).
rows.chinese_translation: 世尊以毛绳、利矛、铁片、铁球、铁床铁凳和铁锅等譬喻，显示接受礼敬、合掌礼、袈裟、食物、床座和住处等信心供养的苦。
rows.translation_note: 本段将多种供养分别与地狱苦作对比。

rows.pali: Tasmā –
rows.chinese_translation: 因此：

rows.pali: Aggikkhandhāliṅganadukkhādhikadukkhakaṭukaphalaṃ;
rows.english: 158. Of pain more violent even than the pain In the embracing of a mass of fire?
rows.chinese_translation: “破戒者拥抱火聚，所得之苦更加剧烈、更加痛苦、果报更加辛辣；

rows.pali: Avijahato kāmasukhaṃ, sukhaṃ kuto bhinnasīlassa.
rows.english: What pleasure has a man of broken virtue Forsaking not sense pleasures, which bear fruit
rows.chinese_translation: 既然如此，他舍弃欲乐还能有什么快乐？

rows.pali: Abhivādanasādiyane, kiṃ nāma sukhaṃ vipannasīlassa;
rows.english: What pleasure has he in accepting homage Who, having failed in virtue, must partake
rows.chinese_translation: 破戒者接受礼敬，有什么快乐？

rows.pali: Daḷhavāḷarajjughaṃsanadukkhādhikadukkhabhāgissa.
rows.english: Of pain that will excel in agony The crushing of his legs with horse-hair ropes?
rows.chinese_translation: 他将承受粗毛绳摩擦所带来的更大痛苦。

rows.pali: Saddhānamañjalikammasādiyane kiṃ sukhaṃ asīlassa;
rows.english: What pleasure has a man devoid of virtue Accepting salutations of the faithful,
rows.chinese_translation: 没有戒的人接受合掌礼，有什么快乐？

rows.pali: Sattippahāradukkhādhimattadukkhassa yaṃhetu.
rows.english: Which is the cause of pain acuter still Than pain produced by stabbing with a spear?
rows.chinese_translation: 那正是造成矛刺之苦的原因。

rows.pali: Cīvaraparibhogasukhaṃ, kiṃ nāma asaṃyatassa;
rows.english: What is the pleasure in the use of garments For one without restraint, whereby in hell
rows.chinese_translation: 不守护诸根的人受用袈裟，有什么快乐？

rows.pali: Yena ciraṃ anubhavitabbo, niraye jalitaayopaṭṭasamphasso.
rows.english: He will for long be forced to undergo The contact of the blazing iron sheet?
rows.chinese_translation: 因为他将长久在地狱感受燃烧铁片的触碰。

rows.pali: Madhuropi piṇḍapāto, halāhalavisūpamo asīlassa;
rows.english: Although to him his alms food may seem tasty, Who has no virtue, it is direst poison,
rows.chinese_translation: 对没有戒的人来说，即使食物甘甜，也像毒药；

rows.pali: Ādittā gilitabbā, ayoguḷā yena cirarattaṃ.
rows.english: Because of which he surely will be made For long to swallow burning iron balls.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为他将长久吞食烧红的铁球。

rows.pali: Sukhasammatopi dukkho, asīlino mañcapīṭhaparibhogo;
rows.english: And when the virtueless make use of couches And chairs, though reckoned pleasing, it is pain
rows.chinese_translation: 没有戒的人受用床座，虽以为快乐，实际上是痛苦；

rows.pali: Yaṃ bādhissanti ciraṃ, jalitaayomañcapīṭhāni.
rows.english: Because they will be tortured long indeed On red-hot blazing iron beds and chairs.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为燃烧的铁床、铁凳将长久折磨他。

rows.pali: Dussīlassa vihāre, saddhādeyyamhi kā nivāsa rati;
rows.english: Then what delight is there for one unvirtuous Inhabiting a dwelling given in faith,
rows.chinese_translation: 破戒者住在信心供养的住处，有什么可喜爱？

rows.pali: Jalitesu nivasitabbaṃ, yena ayokumbhimajjhesu.
rows.english: Since for that reason he will have to dwell Shut up inside a blazing iron pan?
rows.chinese_translation: 因为他将住在燃烧的铁锅中。

rows.pali: Saṅkasarasamācāro, kasambujāto avassuto pāpo;
rows.english: Described him in these terms: “Of suspect habits, Full of corruption, lecherous as well, By nature evil,
rows.chinese_translation: 行为可疑、如粪土般、内里湿污、邪恶的人，

rows.pali: Antopūtīti ca yaṃ, nindanto āha lokagaru.
rows.english: rotten too within.” The Teacher of the world, in him condemning (as before).
rows.chinese_translation: 世界导师以多种方式称责他，说他“内里腐败”。

rows.pali: Dhī jīvitaṃ asaññatassa, tassa samaṇajanavesadhārissa;
rows.english: So out upon the life of him abiding Without restraint, of him that wears the guise
rows.chinese_translation: 没有调伏的人还披着沙门装束，
rows.translation_note: “内里腐败”等是对行为与内心不净的总结性贬称。

rows.pali: Assamaṇassa upahataṃ, khatamattānaṃ vahantassa.
rows.english: Of the ascetic that he will not be, And damages and undermines himself!
rows.chinese_translation: 却承受着毁坏自己、伤害自己的生活，真是可悲。

rows.pali: Gūthaṃ viya kuṇapaṃ viya, maṇḍanakāmā vivajjayantīdha;
rows.english: Avoids it here, as those that would look well Keep far away from dung or from a corpse?
rows.chinese_translation: 世间持戒、清净、寂静的人会远离他，

rows.pali: Yaṃ nāma sīlavanto, santo kiṃ jīvitaṃ tassa.
rows.english: What is the life he leads, since any person, No matter who, with virtue to his credit
rows.chinese_translation: 如同远离粪便和尸体一样；这样的人还有什么生命价值？

rows.pali: Sabbabhayehi amutto, mutto sabbehi adhigamasukhehi;
rows.english: He is not free from any sort of terror, Though free enough from pleasure of attainment;
rows.chinese_translation: 他没有脱离一切恐惧，却离开了一切成就之乐；

rows.pali: Supihitasaggadvāro, apāyamaggaṃ samārūḷho.
rows.english: While heaven’s door is bolted fast against him, He is well set upon the road to hell.
rows.chinese_translation: 他把通往恶趣的道路当作已经走上的路，却把善趣之门严密关闭。

rows.pali: Karuṇāya vatthubhūto, kāruṇikajanassa nāma ko añño;
rows.english: Who else if not one destitute of virtue More fit to be the object of compassion?
rows.chinese_translation: 除了破戒者，还有谁会成为慈悲者的悲悯对象？

rows.pali: Dussīlasamo dussī, latāya iti bahuvidhā dosāti.
rows.english: Many indeed and grave are the defects That brand a man neglectful of his virtue.
rows.chinese_translation: 破戒者就像坏掉的藤蔓，具有多种过失。”

rows.pali: Evamādinā paccavekkhaṇena sīlavipattiyaṃ ādīnavadassanaṃ vuttappakāraviparītato sīlasampattiyā ānisaṃsadassanañca veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: Seeing danger in the failure of virtue should be understood as reviewing in such ways as these. And seeing benefits in perfected virtue should be understood in the opposite sense.
rows.chinese_translation: 应以这样的审察来理解：观察戒行败坏的过患，并反过来观察前述戒行成就的功德。

rows.pali: Apica –
rows.english: 159. Furthermore:
rows.chinese_translation: 此外：

rows.pali: Tassa pāsādikaṃ hoti, pattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ;
rows.english: His virtue is immaculate, His wearing of the bowl and robes
rows.chinese_translation: “戒行极其清净的人，

rows.pali: Pabbajjā saphalā tassa, yassa sīlaṃ sunimmalaṃ.
rows.english: Gives pleasure and inspires trust, His going forth will bear its fruit.
rows.chinese_translation: 穿着钵和袈裟显得庄严；他的出家也有了成果。

rows.pali: Attānuvādādibhayaṃ, suddhasīlassa bhikkhuno;
rows.english: A bhikkhu in his virtue pure Has never fear that self-reproach
rows.chinese_translation: 对于清净戒行的比丘，自我责备等恐惧，
rows.translation_note: 后半转为戒行成就的功德，与前文过患逐项相反。

rows.pali: Andhakāraṃ viya raviṃ, hadayaṃ nāvagāhati.
rows.english: Will enter in his heart: indeed There is no darkness in the sun.
rows.chinese_translation: 不会像黑暗一样侵入心中，因为阳光能驱散黑暗。

rows.pali: Sīlasampattiyā bhikkhu, sobhamāno tapovane;
rows.english: A bhikkhu in his virtue bright Shines forth in the Ascetics’ Wood41
rows.note: 41. An allusion to the Gosiṅga Suttas (MN 31, 32).
rows.chinese_translation: 比丘因戒行成就而在修行林中光彩照人，

rows.pali: Pabhāsampattiyā cando, gagane viya sobhati.
rows.english: As by the brightness of his beams The moon lights up the firmament.
rows.chinese_translation: 如同月亮凭光明在天空中照耀。

rows.pali: Kāyagandhopi pāmojjaṃ, sīlavantassa bhikkhuno;
rows.english: Now, if the bodily perfume Of virtuous bhikkhus can succeed
rows.chinese_translation: 持戒比丘即使身体的气味也能带来欢喜；

rows.pali: Karoti api devānaṃ, sīlagandhe kathāva kā.
rows.english: In pleasing even deities, What of the perfume of his virtue?
rows.chinese_translation: 既然如此，诸天也喜爱戒香，更不必说其他人。

rows.pali: Sabbesaṃ gandhajātānaṃ, sampattiṃ abhibhuyyati;
rows.english: It is more perfect far than all The other perfumes in the world,
rows.chinese_translation: 戒香超越一切香气的功德；

rows.pali: Avighātī disā sabbā, sīlagandho pavāyati.
rows.english: Because the perfume virtue gives Is borne unchecked in all directions.
rows.chinese_translation: 它无阻地向所有方向飘散。

rows.pali: Appakāpi katā kārā, sīlavante mahapphalā;
rows.english: The deeds done for a virtuous man, Though they be few, will bear much fruit,
rows.chinese_translation: 即使对持戒者作很少的供养，也会得到巨大的果报；

rows.pali: Hontīti sīlavā hoti, pūjāsakkārabhājanaṃ.
rows.english: And so the virtuous man becomes A vessel of honour and renown.
rows.chinese_translation: 所以持戒者成为接受礼敬和供养的人。”

rows.pali: Sīlavantaṃ na bādhanti, āsavā diṭṭhadhammikā;
rows.english: There are no cankers here and now To plague the virtuous man at all;
rows.chinese_translation: 漏尽在现法中不会伤害持戒者；
rows.translation_note: āsava 在此指现法中可见的烦恼漏及其结果。

rows.pali: Samparāyikadukkhānaṃ, mūlaṃ khanati sīlavā.
rows.english: The virtuous man digs out the root Of suffering in lives to come.
rows.chinese_translation: 持戒者还会挖断后世痛苦的根。

rows.pali: Yā manussesu sampatti, yā ca devesu sampadā;
rows.english: Perfection among human kind And even among deities.
rows.chinese_translation: 在人间得到的成就，

rows.pali: Na sā sampannasīlassa, icchato hoti dullabhā.
rows.english: If wished for, is not hard to gain For him whose virtue is perfected;
rows.chinese_translation: 以及在天界得到的成就，对于愿求成就的持戒者，都不会难以获得。

rows.pali: Accantasantā pana yā, ayaṃ nibbānasampadā;
rows.english: Than the perfection of Nibbāna, The state where utter peace prevails
rows.chinese_translation: 但最究竟、最寂静的涅槃成就，
rows.translation_note: accantasantā 是极寂静、究竟寂静，指涅槃成就。

rows.pali: Mano sampannasīlassa, tameva anudhāvati.
rows.english: But once his virtue is perfected, His mind then seeks no other kind.
rows.chinese_translation: 持戒圆满者的心只会追随它。

rows.pali: Sabbasampattimūlamhi, sīlamhi iti paṇḍito;
rows.english: So let a wise man know it well This root of all perfection’s branches.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，智者应当在戒这一切成就的根本上，

rows.pali: Anekākāravokāraṃ, ānisaṃsaṃ vibhāvayeti.
rows.english: Such is the blessed fruit of virtue, Showing full many a varied form,
rows.chinese_translation: 明辨戒以各种方式、各种层面呈现的功德。

rows.pali: Evañhi vibhāvayato sīlavipattito ubbijjitvā sīlasampattininnaṃ mānasaṃ hoti.
rows.english: 160. The mind of one who understands thus, shudders at failure in virtue and reaches out towards the perfecting of virtue.
rows.chinese_translation: 这样明辨之后，心便会因戒行败坏而悚惧，转向戒行成就。
rows.translation_note: 本句总结由过患转向功德的修学心理。

rows.pali: Tasmā yathāvuttaṃ imaṃ sīlavipattiyā ādīnavaṃ imañca sīlasampattiyā ānisaṃsaṃ disvā sabbādarena sīlaṃ vodāpetabbanti.
rows.english: So virtue should be cleansed with all care, seeing this danger of failure in virtue and this benefit of the perfection of virtue in the way stated.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，看见前面所说戒行败坏的过患和戒行成就的功德后，应当以最大的恭敬使戒清净。

rows.pali: Ettāvatā ca "sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño"ti imissā gāthāya sīlasamādhipaññāmukhena desite visuddhimagge sīlaṃ tāva paridīpitaṃ hoti.
rows.english: 161.And at this point in the Path of Purification, which is shown under the headings of virtue, concentration and understanding by the stanza, “When a wise man, established well in virtue” (§1), virtue, firstly, has been fully illustrated.
rows.chinese_translation: 至此，在以“人应安住于戒，具足智慧”这一偈颂为起点、通过戒定慧三门宣说的《清净道》中，戒的说明已经完成。
rows.translation_note: 这是第一品戒义说明的收束句。

rows.pali: Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
rows.english: in the Path of Purification composed for the purpose of gladdening good people.
rows.chinese_translation: 这部《清净道论》是为了使善人欢喜而造，

rows.pali: Sīlaniddeso nāma paṭhamo paricchedo.
rows.english: The first chapter called “The Description of Virtue”
rows.chinese_translation: 这里完成了名为“戒的解释”的第一章。
